_comment: Notes for docs/registry.html (scripts/gen_registry.py). Key = id (no namespace = mechanical). text: English, [[id]] becomes a link, **bold**. Optional: category (tools/materials/food/blocks/wildlife/foraging), vanilla: true, name.

plant_fibre.text:
Break Short Grass, Tall Grass, Fern or Large Fern: 20 % chance, **60 % with a knife** (the knife loses 1 durability per grass). Also 2 from [[bark]] + knife (bast), and 1–2 when you chop down a berry bush.
Used for [[twine]].

twine.text: 3 [[plant_fibre]] (shapeless). Binding for flint tools and in the Tool Station (Crude tools), and for [[fire_drill]], [[tool_station]], [[cordage]] and [[drying_rack]].

cordage.text: 3 [[twine]] (shapeless). Binding for the Stone Pickaxe, Stone Axe, [[flint_spear]] and [[tusk_dagger]], and the string in the [[crude_bow]].

tool_rod.text: Place a knife above any Log in crafting (the knife loses 1 durability). Handle for the better tools in the Tool Station.

stone_chunk.text:
Pick up loose stones ([[loose_stone]]) from the ground: small 1, medium 2, large (requires a pickaxe) 3–4. Vanilla Stone also drops 2–4 rock chunks instead of itself.
All four kinds count as rock chunks and can be mixed: stone heads, [[kiln]], and 4 → 1 Cobblestone. Repairs Crude tools.

bark.text:
Hold right-click with an axe on an [[oak_fallen_log]] (any wood type): the first step strips the bark and gives 1–2 Bark.
**Tinder:** right-click with Bark on an unlit Campfire or Clay Kiln, and the [[fire_drill]] then succeeds 75 % of the time. Also used for bast ([[plant_fibre]]) and the [[bark_basket]].

stone_pickaxe_head.text: 3 rock chunks + knife (the knife stays and loses 1 durability). Single-sided head for the [[crude_stone_pickaxe]]. Two heads + knife give a [[double_stone_pickaxe_head]].

double_stone_pickaxe_head.text: Two [[stone_pickaxe_head]] with a knife between them. Head for the vanilla Stone Pickaxe in the Tool Station.

stone_axe_head.text: 3 rock chunks + knife (the knife loses 1 durability). Head for the [[crude_stone_axe]]. Two heads + knife give a [[double_stone_axe_head]].

double_stone_axe_head.text: Two [[stone_axe_head]] with a knife between them. Head for the Stone Axe in the Tool Station.

unfired_crucible.text: Shaped from **7 Clay Balls** at a [[mold_bench]] (no crafting recipe). Fired into a [[crucible]] in a Clay Kiln (800°, 40 s).

unfired_clay_bucket.text: 3 Clay Ball in a bucket shape (`[Clay][ ][Clay]` / `[ ][Clay][ ]`). Fired into a [[clay_bucket]] in a [[kiln]] (30 s).

clay_bucket.text: Fired clay bucket. **Only holds water** (lava and other liquids don't work). Lasts 16 pours, then it cracks.

clay_water_bucket.text: [[clay_bucket]] filled with water. Pour it out like a regular water bucket; every pour wears the bucket.

leather_satchel.text: Sewn in the Armor Station: 4 Leather + [[bone_needle]] + 2 [[wool_thread]]. Right-click for a 9-slot (3x3) storage for anything except other storage items (bags, [[bark_basket]], shulker boxes, bundles). The contents stay with the satchel.

unlit_torch.text: A torch the wind blew out on a windy night. Gives no light. Relight it with a torch, [[fire_drill]] or Flint and Steel; breaking it gives the torch back.

unlit_wall_torch.text: Wall version of the [[unlit_torch]]: a wall torch the wind blew out.

crucible.text: Fire an [[unfired_crucible]] in a [[kiln]] (800°, 40 s). Click **Crushed Copper Ore (1 unit), Native Copper (2), Crushed Tin Ore (1) or Bronze Ingot (2)** onto it in the inventory, up to **10** units. Pure copper melts at 1085°, copper with 8–15 % tin becomes bronze at 950° (the tooltip shows the mix). Does not stack.

tin_ore.text: Tin ore (Bronze Age). **Requires a Copper Pickaxe** (or better; tag `mechanical:needs_copper_tool`). Drops 1–2 [[cassiterite]] (Fortune helps), itself with Silk Touch. Above veins near the surface, [[loose_cassiterite]] lies on the ground.

tin_ingot.text: Tin. Cannot be smelted yet (the Furnace is removed); belongs to the Bronze Age.

tallow.text:
Cook [[lard]] (1) or [[bear_fat]] (2) on a Campfire (20 s). **More in a [[bronze_kettle]]:** Lard → 2, Bear Fat → 3, 2 Bone → 1.
Used for Candles (Twine + 2 Tallow → 2 Candle) and [[fire_arrow]] in the Fletching Table.

bone_fish_hook.text: [[fish_bones]] + knife (crafting, the knife loses 1 durability). Head for the [[bone_hook_fishing_rod]] in the Tool Station.

oak_firewood.text:
All Oak logs (including stripped and wood blocks) drop **2 Oak Firewood** instead of themselves. Felled trees give Firewood via [[oak_fallen_log]] → [[oak_rough_log]] → chop on a stump (2–3).
Builds a [[minecraft:campfire]], fuel in the Clay Kiln (1 min), 2 → Charcoal in the Clay Kiln, and 4 of the same kind → 1 Oak Log. Right-click on embers to relight the fire, or on a burning fire for +1 minute (max 10 min).
**Woodpile:** right-click the top of a solid block → [[oak_firewood_pile]].
The icon shows 1, 2 or 3 logs depending on the stack size.

oak_rough_log.text:
The last step when working a [[oak_fallen_log]] with an axe (if it succeeds, otherwise 2–3 Sticks). Stacks to 16.
**Right-click a [[oak_stump]]** to place it on the stump (an empty hand takes it back). **Hold right-click with an axe** on it: success → 2–3 [[oak_firewood]] (+1 with Stone Axe, +2 Iron Axe, +3 Diamond Axe), failure → 1 Firewood + 1–2 Sticks. Chance: Flint Axe 60 %, Crude Stone Axe 65 %, Stone Axe 75 %, Iron Axe 95 %.

oak_fallen_log.text:
The trunk of a felled Oak tree stays lying as Fallen Logs where it lands. Has no item.
**Hold right-click with an axe** (one heavy chop every 0.6 s, 4 chops per step with Flint Axe, 3 with Stone Axe, 2 with Iron Axe; the axe loses 1 durability per step): bark off (1–2 [[bark]]) → thinner → thinner still → [[oak_rough_log]] (or just 2–3 Sticks if it fails). Broken normally, it only gives 1–2 Sticks.

oak_stump.text:
Left behind where you chopped when a Oak tree is felled. Has no item. Drops 1–2 Sticks, broken fastest with an axe.
Works as a **chopping block**: right-click a [[oak_rough_log]] onto the stump and chop it into Firewood.

flint_pickaxe.text: Mines like wood (stone → cobblestone, but not iron ore). Durability 48, repaired with Flint. Unlocked in the recipe book when you get Flint. Also used as a hammerstone to knap stone heads (stays in the grid, loses 1 durability) and needed for the [[tool_station]].

flint_axe.text:
The first axe, a 2×2 recipe that works in the inventory: Logs cannot be broken without an axe. Mines like wood (stone → cobblestone, but not iron ore). Durability 48, repaired with Flint. Unlocked in the recipe book when you get Flint. 4 damage.
Chop a log in a natural tree → the whole tree is felled (sneak to chop a single log). Hold right-click on Fallen Logs and Rough Logs to work them. Needed for the [[tool_station]]. Planks and Crafting Table require an axe, otherwise they become Sticks.

flint_shovel.text: Mines like wood (stone → cobblestone, but not iron ore). Durability 48, repaired with Flint. Unlocked in the recipe book when you get Flint.

flint_hoe.text: Mines like wood (stone → cobblestone, but not iron ore). Durability 48, repaired with Flint. Unlocked in the recipe book when you get Flint.

flint_knife.text:
Knife: stays in the grid in recipes and loses 1 durability (stone heads, Tool Rod, Scraped Hide, gutting fish, bast, Bone Fish Hook). 2.5 damage, durability 48.
Gives a 60 % chance of [[plant_fibre]] from grass. **Hold right-click on a Carcass** to butcher the animal in two rounds (hide/feathers/wool, then meat). ~2 s per round, the knife loses 1 durability per round. Too weak for the Brown Bear.

iron_knife.text: Iron Age, **not obtainable yet** (available in creative). 2× faster and 1.5× more yield when butchering than the Flint Knife. Can butcher the Brown Bear (like the Tusk Dagger). Works in all knife recipes.

tusk_dagger.text:
Tool Station: head [[tusk]], binding [[cordage]], handle Leather. Unlocked when you have a Tusk.
A knife (works in all knife recipes and for butchering): 1.3× faster and 1.1× more meat than the [[flint_knife]], 140 durability, 3 damage, attack speed 2.2.
**Hunting knife:** can butcher the [[brown_bear]] (the Flint Knife can't) and gives **1.6× more in the first round** (hides, pelts, wool, feathers), e.g. Bear Pelt 1–2 instead of 1.

crude_stone_pickaxe.text: Tool Station: [[stone_pickaxe_head]] + [[twine]] + Stick. Mines like stone but slower, 80 durability. Repaired with rock chunks. Unlocked when you have a rock chunk.

crude_stone_axe.text:
Tool Station: [[stone_axe_head]] + [[twine]] + Stick. Axe, 80 durability, 5.5 damage. Repaired with rock chunks.
Clubber zombies and every tenth skeleton carry one as a club (sometimes dropped, 8.5 %).

fire_pit.text:
8 rock chunks around a Firewood (`RRR`/`RFR`/`RRR`). A large **2×2** campfire: placed like a bed (clicked block + three in front and to the right), on flat solid ground, unlit. Lit with a [[fire_drill]].
**8 food slots** on two spits (Campfire recipes; food burns if left on). Firewood goes on a pile (max 16); the fire burns **twice as fast** as a Campfire and glows for 3 min. Light 15 on all four blocks, monsters and predators keep **1.5× as far away**, warms +15° out to 9 blocks.
**Much more smoke:** indoors 3× as fast, soot 3×, smoke column outdoors. Withstands rain for about 19 min (Campfire 6). The camp ages twice as fast and raids are bigger (+2 raiders, 1.5× chance).
Breaks whole: the Fire Pit, food and wood are returned.

kiln.text:
**Can only be placed on top of a Campfire**, which becomes the kiln's firebox (2 blocks tall). If the Campfire was lit, the kiln bakes on the campfire's wood (3 min). Otherwise: add fuel and light it with a [[fire_drill]].
GUI like a Furnace. Fuel is only used while something is baking; lit without baking it smoulders for 60 s and goes out. Cold and rain make the fuel run out faster. Glows (light 13) and protects against monsters while burning.
Breaking either half returns the Clay Kiln + 1–3 Stick + the contents.
**A new kiln must be fired first:** the clay is raw and the kiln bakes nothing until a fire has burned in it for 2 min (fuel is used). The clay darkens in 3 stages to fired red-brown clay. A fired kiln stays fired even if you break and move it.
**Temperature:** rises 5°/s towards the fuel's max (wood 500°, Firewood/Log 650°, Charcoal 800°), drops 3°/s when unlit. Each recipe needs a temperature (Charcoal 400°, Brick 600°, Crucible 800°, copper melts at 1085°). [[bellows]] raise it (+40° per pump). Overheating at 1300° can crack it; repaired with 4 Clay Ball and fired again.

drying_rack.text:
**Right-click with [[scraped_hide]]** to stretch it. After a few minutes (~3 min on average) it is dry: right-click to take the Leather. Breaking it drops the rack itself + the hide.
**Food dries too:** each meat becomes its own thing: [[venison_jerky]], [[beef_jerky]], [[dried_pork]], [[dried_mutton]], [[game_jerky]], [[small_game_jerky]], [[dried_fowl]], [[dried_seal_meat]], [[stockfish]] (Raw Cod/Pike/Sturgeon), Raw Salmon → [[dried_fish]], [[raw_meat_strips]] → [[jerky]]. Big cuts (Haunch, Ribs, Loin) are too thick and fat-rich meat (Cave Bear, Beaver, Beaver Tail, Walrus) goes rancid: they can't be dried, smoke them instead. Birds hang as birds, fish as fish, 4 berries → 4 [[dried_berries]], 4 edible mushrooms → 4 [[dried_mushrooms]]. Only in sunlight without rain (~7 min in the wind, ~14 min in shelter); night and rain pause it. Rotting food can't be hung.
**Tall rack:** right-click with another Drying Rack → 2 blocks tall with **4 slots** (2 per block) that dry independently. An empty hand takes down everything that is done; breaking one half breaks both.
**Large pelts (tall rack only):** [[raw_bear_pelt]] takes the whole rack (all 4 slots), [[raw_wolf_pelt]] one half (one block). Dries in sunlight without rain (~6 min); night and rain pause it. Gives [[bear_pelt]] / [[wolf_pelt]]; if the rack is broken the pelt drops once.

minecraft:short_grass.name: Short Grass, Tall Grass, Fern

minecraft:stone.text: Stone, Granite, Diorite and Andesite drop **2–4 rock chunks** instead of cobblestone (Silk Touch gives the block). 4 rock chunks → 1 Cobblestone.

minecraft:cobblestone.text: 4 rock chunks → 1 Cobblestone (stone drops chunks instead of cobblestone).

minecraft:stone_pickaxe.text: Vanilla recipe removed. Made in the Tool Station: [[double_stone_pickaxe_head]] + [[cordage]] + [[tool_rod]]. 131 durability.

minecraft:stone_axe.text: Vanilla recipe removed. Made in the Tool Station: [[double_stone_axe_head]] + [[cordage]] + [[tool_rod]]. **250** durability (vanilla 131), **6.5** damage (vanilla 9).

minecraft:fletching_table.text: **Right-click to open** (sneak + right-click to place blocks against it). Three slots + output: arrows ([[minecraft:arrow]], [[bone_arrow]], [[barbed_arrow]], [[fire_arrow]]) and the [[sinew_bow]].

minecraft:arrow.text: Vanilla recipe removed. Made in the Fletching Table: Flint + Stick + Feather → 4 Arrow.

minecraft:candle.text: New recipe: Twine + 2 [[tallow]] → 2 Candle (Honeycomb recipe removed). Lit with a [[fire_drill]] (60 %). Monsters don't break candles, but a zombie horde blows them out.

minecraft:leather.text: Animals no longer drop Leather. Dry [[scraped_hide]] on a [[drying_rack]]. Leather Armor insulates 15 % per piece against cold.

minecraft:feather.text: From butchering Chicken and Parrot (80 %, 1–2) and Pheasant (2–3). Used in the Fletching Table.

minecraft:torch.text: Torches don't protect against monsters and give no warmth. Monsters can be drawn to them and break them; zombie hordes break torches within 10 blocks. Gives dynamic light when held.

minecraft:cod.text: Killing fish and fishing give [[whole_cod]] instead, which must be gutted with a knife. Also applies to Salmon, Tropical Fish and Pufferfish.
minecraft:cod.name: Raw Fish

minecraft:white_wool.text: Can be made from 9 [[wool_thread]] (3×3). When broken it gives 1–3 [[wool_thread]], not the wool (the tents in Abandoned Camps are old cloth).

minecraft:straw_bed.text: The Stone Age bed: right-click to **rest** (sets your respawn point and resets the time since rest, so phantoms stay away). You don't sleep through the night. Recipe: `[Straw][Straw][Straw]` / `[Planks][Planks][Planks]`. When broken it gives 2–4 [[plant_fibre]].

minecraft:charcoal.text: Fired in the Clay Kiln from 1 Log or 2 Firewood (30 s). The best fuel (4 min). Campfires no longer drop Charcoal.

minecraft:brick.text: Fired in the Clay Kiln from 1 Clay Ball (20 s).

minecraft:cow_spawn_egg.text: Cow, Sheep, Pig, Chicken, Horse, Donkey and Llama don't spawn in the wild. The pen gets 4 animals once; they never despawn, but no more will come. Wild animals leave a **Carcass** to butcher with a knife instead of loot.
minecraft:cow_spawn_egg.name: Farm Animals

minecraft:furnace.text: Removed (replaced by the [[kiln]], upgraded later). Smoker and Blast Furnace are also removed.

minecraft:oak_planks.text: 1 Log → **2** Planks (vanilla 4). With a [[bronze_saw]]: Log + Saw → **4** (the saw is kept). Applies to all wood types.
minecraft:oak_planks.name: Planks

boiled_egg.text:
Any egg (regular, blue, brown, [[pheasant_egg]], [[ptarmigan_egg]], [[pigeon_egg]]) on a Campfire (15 s); a [[goose_egg]] gives 2. Stacks to 16. Can't be eaten with the shell on.
**Peel:** Boiled Egg in the crafting grid → [[peeled_egg]] + [[eggshell]].

peeled_egg.text: Peel a [[boiled_egg]] in the crafting grid (also gives [[eggshell]]). 3 hunger.

eggshell.text: Obtained when peeling a [[boiled_egg]]. Works like Bone Meal: **right-click plants**.

armor_station.text: Crafting: Leather, [[bone_needle]], Leather / Planks, Crafting Table, Planks. Right-click to open. Like the Tool Station: the list on the left shows the armor you've unlocked (Leather → leather armor, [[bear_pelt]] → fur armor, [[wolf_pelt]] → Wolf Hood and Wolf Fur); click to fill in the parts. The Bone Needle stays in and loses 1 per piece.

bone_needle.text: Fish Bones, Bone or [[horn]] + knife (crafting). 32 durability. Tool for the [[armor_station]]: loses 1 per sewn armor piece.

twigs.text: Small twigs on the ground in forests and taiga. Break → 1 Stick.

aspen_log.text:
New wood type. Tall, slender, straight trunk (9–13 blocks) with a small crown at the top. Grows in Forest and Flower Forest, and sparsely in Meadow and Taiga.
Felled like other trees (the whole tree falls, [[aspen_stump]] and [[aspen_fallen_log]]). A broken Log gives 2 [[aspen_firewood]]. An axe (right-click) makes Stripped Aspen Log.

aspen_planks.text: 1 Aspen Log (or Wood/Stripped) → 2 Planks (like all wood types in the Stone Age). Makes Slab, Stairs, Fence, Fence Gate, Door, Trapdoor, Button and Pressure Plate with the usual vanilla recipes.

aspen_leaves.text: Leaves of Aspen trees. Sometimes drop [[aspen_sapling]] and Sticks, like other leaves (no apples). Shears or Silk Touch give the leaf block itself.

aspen_sapling.text: Drops from [[aspen_leaves]]. Plant it on dirt and it grows into a Aspen tree. Can be placed in a Flower Pot.

aspen_firewood.text:
All Aspen logs (including stripped and wood blocks) drop **2 Aspen Firewood** instead of themselves. Felled trees give Firewood via [[aspen_fallen_log]] → [[aspen_rough_log]] → chop on a stump (2–3).
Builds a [[minecraft:campfire]], fuel in the Clay Kiln (1 min), 2 → Charcoal in the Clay Kiln, and 4 of the same kind → 1 Aspen Log. Right-click embers to relight the fire, or a burning fire for +1 minute (max 10 min).
**Woodpile:** right-click the top of a solid block → [[aspen_firewood_pile]].
The icon shows 1, 2 or 3 logs depending on the stack size.

aspen_rough_log.text:
The last step when working a [[aspen_fallen_log]] with an axe (on success, otherwise 2–3 Sticks). Stacks to 16.
**Right-click a [[aspen_stump]]** to set it on the stump (an empty hand takes it back). **Hold right-click with an axe** on it: success → 2–3 [[aspen_firewood]] (+1 with Stone Axe, +2 Iron Axe, +3 Diamond Axe), failure → 1 Firewood + 1–2 Sticks. Chance: Flint Axe 60 %, Crude Stone Axe 65 %, Stone Axe 75 %, Iron Axe 95 %.

aspen_fallen_log.text:
The trunk of a felled Aspen tree stays lying as Fallen Logs where it lands. Has no item.
**Hold right-click with an axe** (one heavy chop every 0.6 s, 4 chops per step with a Flint Axe, 3 with a Stone Axe, 2 with an Iron Axe; the axe wears 1 per step): bark off (1–2 [[bark]]) → thinner → thinner still → [[aspen_rough_log]] (or just 2–3 Sticks on failure). Broken normally it gives only 1–2 Sticks.

aspen_stump.text:
Left behind where you chopped when a Aspen tree is felled. Has no item. Gives 1–2 Sticks, breaks fastest with an axe.
Works as a **chopping block**: right-click an [[aspen_rough_log]] onto the stump and chop it into Firewood.

alder_log.text:

Felled like other trees (the whole tree falls, [[alder_stump]] and [[alder_fallen_log]]). A broken Log gives 2 [[alder_firewood]]. An axe (right-click) makes Stripped Alder Log.

structure:abandoned_campsite.text: Abandoned camp: extinguished campfire, Drying Rack, Bone Pile and a Decorated Pot with flint, cordage and food.

structure:hunters_lean_to.text: A hunter's lean-to of logs and hides, with a Bear Rug; the pot holds hides, arrows and rarely a Crude Bow.

structure:bear_den.text: Bear den: a cave in a hillside or a pit under the root plate of a fallen tree, with a bed, bones and a pot. A Brown Bear lives there and goes out during the day. Dangerous but good loot.

structure:standing_stones.text: Stone circle with leaning and broken stones and an altar stone. Landmark, some flint and bones.

structure:burial_mound.text: Burial mound with a stone-lined passage into a dark chamber: skull, bones, bone tools, horn and antler.

structure:fishing_camp.text: Fishing camp by the water with drying racks and a jetty: hooks, fish and rarely a Crude Fishing Rod.

structure:flint_quarry.text: Gravel and stone pit full of Loose Flint, with half-finished stone heads and rarely a Flint Knife.

structure:mammoth_bone_hut.text: A dome of bone blocks in the snow: Tusk, bones, sinew and rarely a Bear Pelt.

structure:hermits_hut.text: Small hut deep in the forest with a hermit (leatherworker) who trades Stone Age goods.

structure:glacial_erratic.text: A large glacial erratic of foreign stone (granite, diorite, deepslate, tuff...) half sunk into open ground.

structure:mossy_boulder.text: Mossy boulder in the forest, with moss and ferns around it.

structure:sandstone_boulder.text: Sandstone boulder in deserts and badlands.

structure:cairn.text: A stacked stone pile or stone tower. Sometimes a pot hidden inside the pile.

structure:balanced_rock.text: A wide rock balanced on a narrow stem.

structure:rune_stone.text: Flat standing stone with carved symbols.

structure:stone_head.text: Giant stone face sunk to the chin.

structure:animal_carving.text: Deer, bear or wild boar carved in stone.

structure:shrine_statue.text: Stone figure on a small plaza with steps, candles, flowers and a pot of offerings.

entity:aurochs.text: Aurochs: large wild cattle on plains. Bulls fight back.

entity:grey_wolf.text: Grey wolf in packs (3–6) in taiga, forest, plains and snowy lands. Sleeps during the day, **hunts at night**: howls, tracks scent, surrounds and bites. Afraid of fire and torches (except during a blood moon). 14 health, 4 damage. Drops [[wolf_pelt]], meat, Sinew and Bone.

entity:cave_lion.text: Cave lion (1–2) in savanna, plains and windswept hills. Stalks crouched in the dark and **pounces on you from behind** (8 damage). Drags prey away. Afraid of fire. 30 health. Drops Raw Hide, meat, Sinew and Bone.

entity:brown_bear.text: Very aggressive bear found near berry bushes. Requires a Tusk Dagger to butcher.

entity:hare.text: Fast and shy. A little meat and hide.

entity:moose.text: Moose: big and strong, bulls fight back. Antler trophy.

entity:mouflon.text: Wild sheep in the mountains. Wool, meat and horns.

entity:pheasant.text: Pheasant that flushes into the air when startled. Leaves a Carcass: pluck it (2–3 feathers) and butcher it into [[raw_pheasant]], or take [[plucked_pheasant]] whole. Nests in [[bird_nest]] in forests and lays [[pheasant_egg]].

entity:red_deer.text: Red deer in herds. Stags fight back. Antler trophy.

entity:reindeer.text: Reindeer in snowy biomes, in herds. Antler trophy.

entity:roe_deer.text: Roe deer, shy and common in forests.

entity:wild_boar.text: Wild boar in groups, attacks when hurt. Lard and Tusk.

entity:wild_horse.text: Wild horse on the plains, in herds.

hazel_shrub.text: Two-block-tall hazel shrub in broadleaf forests; right-click for 1–2 [[hazelnuts]] (regrow), drops 1–3 Sticks when broken.

juniper.text: Low, dense juniper shrub in taiga and windswept hills; pick [[juniper_berries]] (regrow), drops Sticks.

bramble.text: Thorny thicket that slows and pricks you (not while sneaking); drops Plant Fibre and sometimes a Stick.

undergrowth.text: Low brush and ferns on the forest floor; sometimes a Plant Fibre.

heather.text: Heather: low pinkish-purple brush on Pine Heath. Can be walked through. Sometimes drops a Plant Fibre; with Shears, the block itself. Can be composted.

sapling_thicket.text: Two-block-tall thicket of young stems; drops 2–3 Sticks.

hazelnuts.text: From [[hazel_shrub]]. 2 food, roasted on a Campfire into [[roasted_hazelnuts]].

juniper_berries.text: Juniper berries from [[juniper]]. 1 food, maybe a spice later.

ancient_oak_log.text: Trunk of the ancient oak; unbreakable, seamless furrowed bark in three random variants.

ancient_oak_wood.text: Ancient oak with bark on all sides (branches, roots, root legs); unbreakable.

ancient_oak_branch.text: Thick branch (8 px) of the ancient oak; unbreakable, only from world generation.

ancient_oak_twig.text: Thin twig (4 px) at the outer edge of the crown and on the roots; unbreakable.

ancient_oak_leaves.text: Leaves of the ancient oak that never decay; unbreakable.

offering_altar.text: Stone altar inside the hollow oak. Displays an item; a Giant Antler starts the ritual that grants a mythic item.

thunderstone.text: Thunderstone, a mythic stone axe from the [[offering_altar]]: 3000 durability, best chopping, lightning against monsters (1 in 8), lightning immunity.

mistletoe_charm.text: Mythic, from the [[offering_altar]]: slow healing and poison immunity in the hotbar or offhand.

ancient_amber.text: Mythic amber with an insect, from the [[offering_altar]]: glows in the hand, wild animals don't notice you while sneaking.

heart_of_the_oak.text: Mythic, from the [[offering_altar]]: grows saplings instantly (30 s cooldown) and gives double wood when chopping.

antler_crown.text: Mythic helmet from the [[offering_altar]]: night vision, animals only notice you within 3 blocks.

structure:trail.name: Trails
structure:trail.text: Trodden paths (Dirt Path, Coarse Dirt, Gravel, Packed Mud) between nearby villages and the Ancient Oak (tag mechanical:trail_connected), with plank bridges over deep water, stepping stones in shallow water and small cairns.

structure:ancient_oak.name: Ancient Oak
structure:ancient_oak.text: Huge enchanted oak (about 48 blocks tall, 53 wide, trunk 22 blocks across at ground level) with a hollow trunk and an Offering Altar. Find it with /locate structure mechanical:ancient_oak.

entity:tribesperson.text: Stone Age human with a role (Hunter, Gatherer, Fisher, Woodcutter, Elder). Lives in camps, hunting bands or villages, never despawns, and belongs to a tribe with a name and banner. Each player has a reputation with each tribe (hitting, killing, theft and broken campfires lower it; trading and gifts raise it). Only armed ones fight monsters; the others flee. Without a campfire the group builds a new one. Once your camp has burned for 3 days, bands come to visit (the leader talks through a screen: trade, and in the evening whether they may stay by your fire; yes earns a gift at dawn). After a good night a tribe may settle 50-150 blocks away and build a camp in three stages (tents, a bigger camp, a palisade) from wood, stone and hides they gather, and send traders to you; paths wear in between the camps.

structure:tribe_camp.name: Tribe Camp
structure:tribe_camp.text: Camp with a burning Campfire, 2–3 hide tents, a Drying Rack and 3–5 Stone Age humans (Elder, Gatherers, Woodcutters, Fishers).

structure:hunting_band.name: Hunting Band
structure:hunting_band.text: 2–3 Hunters who roam the forest together hunting game. No blocks.

squirrel_pelt.text: Small squirrel pelt from a Squirrel. 4 pelts + Twine → Raw Hide.

giant_antler.text: Giant antler from a Giant Deer (epic). Offered at the [[offering_altar]] in the Ancient Oak for a mythic item.

entity:squirrel.text: Shy squirrel that climbs up trees when startled. Drops Squirrel Pelt.

entity:hedgehog.text: Nocturnal hedgehog that curls up instead of fleeing and pricks anyone who hits it bare-handed.

entity:badger.text: Badger in sloping forests. Flees, but bites hard if hurt or cornered.

entity:giant_deer.text: Rare miniboss with palmate antlers, 120 hp. **Keen eyes:** sees players 48 blocks away (32 sneaking), and any damage from a player (arrows from any range) turns it on the shooter. Winds up visibly (head down, snorting, stomping for about 1.2 s), then charges straight at where you stood at about 9 blocks/s: step aside. Pants for 1.5 s after each charge. If you stand in a tree it rams the tree down; if it can't reach you (a pillar) it backs off out of bow range and into cover until you come down. Only bleeds and flees for cover at 25 % hp. Always drops a [[giant_antler]].

ancient_oak_rune_log.text: Rune bark with a glowing rune (light 6) spiraling up the Ancient Oak; specks of light drift from it. Unbreakable.

glowcap.text: Small glowing mushroom (light 8) by the Ancient Oak's roots, in the hollow and in a fairy ring in the clearing. Can be picked.

spirit_bloom.text: Pale cyan-white glowing flower (light 10) in the Ancient Oak's clearing. Can be picked and planted on dirt, grass and moss.

glow_moss.text: Thin moss carpet with glowing specks (light 5), in patches beneath the Ancient Oak. Can be picked.

structure:tribe_village.name: Tribe Village
structure:tribe_village.text: Rare tribal village: a round palisade of logs topped with [[sharpened_oak_log]], a gate with the tribe's banner, a Longhouse, huts and tents around a large campfire, a flagpole, Drying Racks, storage and workstations. 10–12 Stone Age humans of one tribe; the tribe's mood (Peaceful, Wary, Raiders, Traders) sets roles, style and how they receive you.

sharpened_oak_log.text: Sharpened oak log: oak log + flint (shapeless). Tops the palisades in [[structure:tribe_village]]. Falling onto it doubles the fall damage.

sharpened_spruce_log.text: Sharpened spruce log: spruce log + flint (shapeless). Tops the palisades in [[structure:tribe_village]]. Falling onto it doubles the fall damage.

entity:crow.text: Hooded crow living in flocks on plains and in forests. The whole flock takes off when you get close; one arrow kills. Feathers and a little meat.

entity:goose.text: Greylag goose by rivers and swamps. Flies in V formation and lands on the water. One arrow kills. Leaves a Carcass: pluck it (3–5 feathers), butcher it into 2 [[raw_goose]] or take [[plucked_goose]] whole. Nests in [[bird_nest]] by the water, sometimes lands at the nest and lays [[goose_egg]].

entity:rock_dove.text: Rock dove in mountains and on meadows. Fast flock that takes off together. One arrow kills. Leaves a Carcass: pluck it (1–2 feathers), butcher it into [[raw_pigeon]] or take [[plucked_pigeon]] whole. Nests in [[bird_nest]] on bare cliffs and lays [[pigeon_egg]].

entity:ptarmigan.text: Willow ptarmigan in snow and taiga, white where it snows. Holds still for a long time and flies low and short. One arrow kills. Leaves a Carcass: pluck it (2–3 feathers), butcher it into [[raw_ptarmigan]] or take [[plucked_ptarmigan]] whole. Nests in [[bird_nest]] on the ground and lays [[ptarmigan_egg]].

entity:seagull.text: Gull that circles over water, screeches and dives where there are fish. Rests on the beach. One arrow kills; feathers.

entity:desert_hare.text: Sand-colored hare in deserts and badlands. Shy and fast; butchered like a regular hare.

malachite.text:
Green copper ore. Picked up from [[loose_malachite]] on the ground above copper veins.
Crushed on the [[stone_anvil]] → 1 [[crushed_copper_ore]].

native_copper.text:
Pure copper. Sometimes among the surface finds above copper veins ([[loose_native_copper]], ~15 %) and rarely from panning with a [[pan]].
Not crushed; meant to be smelted directly (Bronze Age phase 3, not built yet).

cassiterite.text:
Tin stone. From [[tin_ore]] (1–2, requires a Copper Pickaxe), [[loose_cassiterite]] on the ground above tin veins, and rarely from panning with a [[pan]] (~4 %).
Crushed on the [[stone_anvil]] → 1 [[crushed_tin_ore]].

crushed_copper_ore.text: From the [[stone_anvil]]: Raw Copper → 2, [[malachite]] → 1. **No use yet** (smelted in Bronze Age phase 3).

crushed_tin_ore.text: From the [[stone_anvil]]: [[cassiterite]] → 1. Put in a [[crucible]] with copper (1 unit): 8–15 % tin melts into bronze at 950° (9–11.5 % = good Bronze, otherwise Poor Bronze). Can be washed in a [[pan]] into [[tin_concentrate]] (2 units).

pan.text:
Gold pan, 64 uses. Crafting: Planks + [[twine]] (`[P][ ][P]` / `[T][P][T]`).
Right-click Gravel or Sand (Red Sand too): the block is picked up and the pan becomes [[pan_with_gravel]] / [[pan_with_sand]].
Empty pan with [[crushed_copper_ore]] / [[crushed_tin_ore]] in the offhand: hold Use in water (3 s) → 1 [[copper_concentrate]] / [[tin_concentrate]], wears 1.

pan_with_gravel.text: Hold Use while standing in or aiming at water (3 s). Often nothing; otherwise Flint, [[stone_chunk]], [[cassiterite]] or rarely [[native_copper]]. In rivers, beaches and stony shores, an extra chance at Cassiterite. The pan becomes empty again and wears 1.

pan_with_sand.text: Like [[pan_with_gravel]] but with sand: less flint and stone, slightly more [[cassiterite]], nothing more often.

loose_malachite.text: Surface find above copper ore (within ~64 blocks below the surface, in the same chunk). Picked up by hand → [[malachite]].

loose_native_copper.text: Rarer surface find above copper ore (~15 % of finds). Picked up by hand → [[native_copper]].

loose_cassiterite.text: Surface find above [[tin_ore]] (within ~64 blocks below the surface, in the same chunk). Picked up by hand → [[cassiterite]].

stone_anvil.text:
Flat stone for crushing ore. Crafting: `[R][K][R]` / `[C][C][C]` (R = rock chunk, K = [[flint_pickaxe]], which is kept and takes wear, C = Cobblestone).
Right-click with ore to place one on the stone; an empty hand takes it back. Strike 4 times with a Flint Pickaxe, Crude Stone Pickaxe or Stone Pickaxe (left- or right-click; the hammer wears 1 per strike): Raw Copper → 2 [[crushed_copper_ore]], [[malachite]] → 1, [[cassiterite]] → 1 [[crushed_tin_ore]].

barley_grain.text:
Seed and food in one. Obtained by threshing [[barley_sheaf]] (villages don't provide any yet; barley will come from trading/chests later).
Sown on farmland → [[barley_crop]]. 2 Grain + Clay Water Bucket + Bowl → [[raw_porridge]]. Ground in a [[quern]] → [[flour]].

barley_sheaf.text:
Mature [[barley_crop]] drops 1 sheaf (with a [[flint_sickle]]: +50 % chance of another and 1 [[straw]]).
Threshed with a [[flail]] on stone → 1–3 [[barley_grain]] + 1 [[straw]]; in the crafting grid → 1 Grain.

einkorn_grain.text:
Seed and food in one. Obtained from [[wild_einkorn]] (knife/sickle 100 %, by hand 50 %) or by threshing [[einkorn_sheaf]].
Sown on farmland → [[einkorn_crop]]. 2 Grain + Clay Water Bucket + Bowl → [[raw_porridge]]. Ground in a [[quern]] → [[flour]].

einkorn_sheaf.text:
Mature [[einkorn_crop]] drops 1 sheaf (with a [[flint_sickle]]: +50 % chance of another and 1 [[straw]]).
Threshed with a [[flail]] on stone → 1–3 [[einkorn_grain]] + 1 [[straw]]; in the crafting grid → 1 Grain.

emmer_grain.text:
Seed and food in one. Obtained from [[wild_emmer]] (knife/sickle 100 %, by hand 50 %) or by threshing [[emmer_sheaf]].
Sown on farmland → [[emmer_crop]]. 2 Grain + Clay Water Bucket + Bowl → [[raw_porridge]]. Ground in a [[quern]] → [[flour]].

emmer_sheaf.text:
Mature [[emmer_crop]] drops 1 sheaf (with a [[flint_sickle]]: +50 % chance of another and 1 [[straw]]).
Threshed with a [[flail]] on stone → 1–3 [[emmer_grain]] + 1 [[straw]]; in the crafting grid → 1 Grain.

barley_crop.text: Crop on farmland, sown with [[barley_grain]]. Temperature 5–16 (best 8–12), frost below 0 – hardy, grows in taiga. Mature: 1 [[barley_sheaf]]. Immature: nothing.

einkorn_crop.text: Crop on farmland, sown with [[einkorn_grain]]. Temperature 7–17 (best 10–14), frost below 2. Mature: 1 [[einkorn_sheaf]]. Immature: 0–1 Grain (still a wild type).

emmer_crop.text: Crop on farmland, sown with [[emmer_grain]]. Temperature 7–17 (best 10–14), frost below 2. Mature: 1 [[emmer_sheaf]]. Immature: 0–1 Grain (still a wild type).

pea_crop.text: Peas on farmland, sown with [[peas]]. Temperature 6–16 (best 9–13), frost below 2. Mature: 1–3 [[peas]], and the harvest **raises** fertility by 1 instead of lowering it. Immature: nothing.

peas.text: Food (1 hunger) and seed for [[pea_crop]]. From [[wild_pea]] (1–2) or farmed peas (1–3).

wild_einkorn.text: Wild einkorn in small, rare stands on plains, sunflower plains, meadow and savanna. Knife or [[flint_sickle]]: 1 [[einkorn_grain]], by hand 50 %.

wild_emmer.text: Wild emmer on plains, sparsely in forest and flower forest. Knife or [[flint_sickle]]: 1 [[emmer_grain]], by hand 50 %.

wild_pea.text: Wild pea (climbing plant) in forest, flower forest, birch forest and meadow. Drops 1–2 [[peas]].

wild_carrot_plant.text: Wild carrot (Daucus carota) with white umbel flowers on plains, sunflower plains, meadow, flower forest and Hazel Meadow (1/12 per chunk). Knife or [[flint_sickle]]: 1–2 [[wild_carrot]], by hand 1 at 50 %.

wild_carrot.text: Thin, pale wild root. Poor food (1 hunger, 0.3 saturation), keeps 10 days (4× longer in a dug-in [[root_cellar]]). Sown on farmland as [[wild_carrot_crop]].

wild_carrot_crop.text: Wild carrots on farmland, sown with [[wild_carrot]]. Same conditions as Carrot (4–15, frost below −1). Ripe: 1–2 [[wild_carrot]] and **25 % chance of a real Carrot**. Unripe: nothing.

sea_beet.text: Sea beet on beaches and stony shores (grows on sand, gravel, stone and soil). Gives 1–3 [[sea_beet_leaves]] and Beetroot Seeds: ~45 % with knife/sickle, 15 % by hand. The wild source of beetroot.

sea_beet_leaves.text: Edible leaves of [[sea_beet]] (1 hunger, 0.2 saturation). Keeps only 1 day.

root_cellar.text: Recipe: Planks + [[straw]] + Planks / Planks + empty + Planks / 3 Planks. A plank bin lined with straw, with a lid, 9 slots. **Dug in** (sky light at most 7 on all sides) root crops and leaves age at **1/4** of the normal rate, other food 1/2. No effect above ground.

minecraft:potato.text: Doesn't grow wild (it comes from the Americas) and isn't found in villages, chests or zombie drops. **Only source:** 1 tribe Elder in 8 (1 in 3 in a Traders tribe) trades 4 Leather + 1 Antler → 3 Potato. Keeps 20 days.

minecraft:carrot.text: From the villages' dying fields and from [[wild_carrot_crop]] (25 % per ripe harvest). Ripe gives 1–2. Keeps 10 days.

minecraft:beetroot_seeds.text: From [[sea_beet]] on the shore, village fields and ripe beetroots (0–1).

withered_crop.text: What remains when frost, drought or root rot kills a young plant. Broken: 50 % [[straw]], otherwise [[plant_fibre]].

straw.text: From threshing ([[flail]]) and harvesting with a [[flint_sickle]]. Composted in a [[compost_heap]]; used for the [[scarecrow]] (Bronze Age).

raw_porridge.text: 2 Grain (any kind) + [[clay_water_bucket]] + Bowl (shapeless; the bucket is returned empty and wears 1). Cooked on a Campfire (20 s) → [[porridge]].

porridge.text: Porridge: 5 hunger, 0.6 saturation. The Bowl is returned. The Stone Age's grain food.

flint_sickle.text: Tool Station: Flint + Twine + Stick (unlocked by Flint). Cuts crops and grass quickly; mature grain gives a +50 % chance of an extra sheaf and 1 [[straw]], wild grain always gives Grain. Wears 1 per mature crop. Durability 48.

flail.text: Recipe: `[ ][Stick]` / `[Twine][Stick]` / `[Stick][ ]`. Hold sheaves in the offhand and right-click a hard surface (stone, cobblestone, gravel, [[stone_anvil]] …): on average every third strike turns a sheaf into 1–3 Grain + 1 [[straw]]. Wears 1 per sheaf, durability 64.

flour.text: Ground from Grain in a [[quern]] (1 Grain → 1 Flour, 4 clicks). 2 Flour + [[clay_water_bucket]] → [[dough]]. Replaces wheat in Cookie and Cake. Keeps for 30 days.

dough.text: 2 [[flour]] + [[clay_water_bucket]] (shapeless). Baked on a [[baking_stone]] (30 s) or in a Clay Kiln (20 s at 200°) → Bread. Keeps for 1 day, then becomes Spoiled Food.

compost.text: From a [[compost_heap]] (2 per full heap). Right-click farmland (or the crop on it): fertility +1.

manure.text: Adult cows, mooshrooms, sheep, pigs, goats, horses, donkeys, mules, aurochs and wild horses drop on average 1 Manure every 10 minutes. Right-click farmland: fertility +2. In a [[compost_heap]] it fills 2 stages.

quern.text: Hand mill. Recipe: `[ ][C][ ]` / `[Cobblestone][Stick][Cobblestone]` / `[Cobblestone]×3` (C = Copper or Bronze Ingot, the metal axle). Right-click with Grain: the upper stone turns a quarter turn; a full turn (4 clicks) grinds 1 Grain → 1 [[flour]].

baking_stone.text: Recipe: `[R][C][R]` (R = rock chunk, C = Copper or Bronze Ingot). Flat stone next to (or on top of) a burning Campfire. Right-click with [[dough]]: after 30 s of fire it is Bread, after 45 s burnt (Burnt Food). An empty hand takes it off.

compost_heap.text: Recipe: `[Stick][ ][Stick]` / `[Stick][Leaf Litter][Stick]` / `[Stick][C][Stick]` (C = Copper or Bronze Ingot). Wattle pen for plant scraps. Right-click with Leaf Litter, [[straw]], Plant Fibre, leaves, saplings, Spoiled Food, rotten flesh, bark, fish bones, roots …: 7 stages fill it ([[manure]] counts as 2), then it rots for 2 min (steam) and yields 2 [[compost]].

scarecrow.text: Recipe: `[C][Carved Pumpkin][ ]` / `[Straw][Raw Hide][Straw]` / `[ ][Stick][ ]` (C = Copper or Bronze Ingot, a bell on the arm). Two-block-tall scarecrow (post, hide tunic stuffed with straw, pumpkin head). Within 12 blocks, no crows land on the field and they eat nothing.

minecraft:wheat.text: Now called **Wheat Sheaf**. Mature wheat drops 1 (with a [[flint_sickle]] +50 % and 1 [[straw]]), immature nothing. Threshed with a [[flail]] → 1–3 Wheat Grain + Straw. 9 → Hay Bale as usual. No bread recipe (bread comes via [[flour]] and [[dough]]).

minecraft:wheat_seeds.text: Now called **Wheat Grain**: wheat's seed and food. Obtained by threshing Wheat Sheaf, in village chests and from the farmer. Sown as usual. 2 Grain + Clay Water Bucket + Bowl → [[raw_porridge]].

minecraft:bread.text: The 3 Wheat recipe is **removed**. Bread is baked from [[dough]] on a [[baking_stone]] or in a Clay Kiln (Bronze Age). Keeps for 3 days.

minecraft:farmland.text: Now has **fertility 0–3** (new field 2, from Podzol 3). Harvesting lowers it by 1 (peas raise it by 1), fallow raises it ~1 per day, [[compost]] +1, [[manure]] +2. Fertility 0: half speed and half yield; 1: 75 % speed; 3: faster and a chance of extra. Dries out faster when it's warm (above 15). Sneak + right-click with an empty hand: shows fertility, moisture and the crop's temperature. Watered with a [[clay_water_bucket]] (3×3).

soot.text:
Thin black layer of soot (block) that builds up on ceilings and walls near a burning fire (lit Campfire, Soul Campfire, Clay Kiln) after 2 min, faster in smoky rooms; 3 stages from a light smudge to thick soot. Rain doesn't wash it off. The block can't be obtained as an item: scrape it off (4× faster with a knife) to get the item Soot (stage 1: 50 % for 1, 2: 1, 3: 2; +1 with a knife).
Soot is a black pigment: 1 Soot → 1 Black Dye. Patches fade out over a block or two (the middle only gets darker once its neighbours have caught up). A [[broom]] sweeps it off one stage at a time in a 3×3.

clay_ingot_mold.text: Fired clay mold placed on the ground. Right-click with a [[molten_crucible]] to pour (2 units); the metal solidifies in 5 s, and an empty hand takes out [[minecraft:copper_ingot]]. Lasts **5 casts**, then it cracks. Fired from [[unfired_clay_ingot_mold]] in a [[kiln]] (600°).

unfired_clay_ingot_mold.text: Shaped from **5 Clay Balls** at a [[mold_bench]] (no crafting recipe). Fired into a [[clay_ingot_mold]] in a [[kiln]] (600°, 20 s).

clay_pickaxe_head_mold.text: Fired clay mold placed on the ground. Right-click with a [[molten_crucible]] to pour (6 units); the metal solidifies in 5 s, and an empty hand takes out [[rough_cast_copper_pickaxe_head]]. Lasts **5 casts**, then it cracks. Fired from [[unfired_clay_pickaxe_head_mold]] in a [[kiln]] (600°).

unfired_clay_pickaxe_head_mold.text: Shaped from **7 Clay Balls** at a [[mold_bench]] (no crafting recipe). Fired into a [[clay_pickaxe_head_mold]] in a [[kiln]] (600°, 20 s).

clay_axe_head_mold.text: Fired clay mold placed on the ground. Right-click with a [[molten_crucible]] to pour (6 units); the metal solidifies in 5 s, and an empty hand takes out [[rough_cast_copper_axe_head]]. Lasts **5 casts**, then it cracks. Fired from [[unfired_clay_axe_head_mold]] in a [[kiln]] (600°).

unfired_clay_axe_head_mold.text: Shaped from **7 Clay Balls** at a [[mold_bench]] (no crafting recipe). Fired into a [[clay_axe_head_mold]] in a [[kiln]] (600°, 20 s).

clay_shovel_head_mold.text: Fired clay mold placed on the ground. Right-click with a [[molten_crucible]] to pour (2 units); the metal solidifies in 5 s, and an empty hand takes out [[rough_cast_copper_shovel_head]]. Lasts **5 casts**, then it cracks. Fired from [[unfired_clay_shovel_head_mold]] in a [[kiln]] (600°).

unfired_clay_shovel_head_mold.text: Shaped from **5 Clay Balls** at a [[mold_bench]] (no crafting recipe). Fired into a [[clay_shovel_head_mold]] in a [[kiln]] (600°, 20 s).

clay_hoe_head_mold.text: Fired clay mold placed on the ground. Right-click with a [[molten_crucible]] to pour (4 units); the metal solidifies in 5 s, and an empty hand takes out [[rough_cast_copper_hoe_head]]. Lasts **5 casts**, then it cracks. Fired from [[unfired_clay_hoe_head_mold]] in a [[kiln]] (600°).

unfired_clay_hoe_head_mold.text: Shaped from **6 Clay Balls** at a [[mold_bench]] (no crafting recipe). Fired into a [[clay_hoe_head_mold]] in a [[kiln]] (600°, 20 s).

clay_knife_blade_mold.text: Fired clay mold placed on the ground. Right-click with a [[molten_crucible]] to pour (2 units); the metal solidifies in 5 s, and an empty hand takes out [[rough_cast_copper_knife_blade]]. Lasts **5 casts**, then it cracks. Fired from [[unfired_clay_knife_blade_mold]] in a [[kiln]] (600°).

unfired_clay_knife_blade_mold.text: Shaped from **4 Clay Balls** at a [[mold_bench]] (no crafting recipe). Fired into a [[clay_knife_blade_mold]] in a [[kiln]] (600°, 20 s).

rough_cast_copper_pickaxe_head.text: Cast in a [[clay_pickaxe_head_mold]] (6 units of copper). Ground on a [[whetstone]] (4 strokes) into [[copper_pickaxe_head]].

copper_pickaxe_head.text: Ground on a [[whetstone]] from [[rough_cast_copper_pickaxe_head]]. Assembled in the Tool Station into [[minecraft:copper_pickaxe]].

rough_cast_copper_axe_head.text: Cast in a [[clay_axe_head_mold]] (6 units of copper). Ground on a [[whetstone]] (4 strokes) into [[copper_axe_head]].

copper_axe_head.text: Ground on a [[whetstone]] from [[rough_cast_copper_axe_head]]. Assembled in the Tool Station into [[minecraft:copper_axe]].

rough_cast_copper_shovel_head.text: Cast in a [[clay_shovel_head_mold]] (2 units of copper). Ground on a [[whetstone]] (4 strokes) into [[copper_shovel_head]].

copper_shovel_head.text: Ground on a [[whetstone]] from [[rough_cast_copper_shovel_head]]. Assembled in the Tool Station into [[minecraft:copper_shovel]].

rough_cast_copper_hoe_head.text: Cast in a [[clay_hoe_head_mold]] (4 units of copper). Ground on a [[whetstone]] (4 strokes) into [[copper_hoe_head]].

copper_hoe_head.text: Ground on a [[whetstone]] from [[rough_cast_copper_hoe_head]]. Assembled in the Tool Station into [[minecraft:copper_hoe]].

rough_cast_copper_knife_blade.text: Cast in a [[clay_knife_blade_mold]] (2 units of copper). Ground on a [[whetstone]] (4 strokes) into [[copper_knife_blade]].

copper_knife_blade.text: Ground on a [[whetstone]] from [[rough_cast_copper_knife_blade]]. Assembled in the Tool Station into [[copper_knife]].

bellows.text: Placed next to a [[kiln]]'s firebox (or against a wall of a Smelting Furnace, best at a tuyere hole, see [[furnace_bricks]]) with the nozzle facing it. **Right-click = one pump: +40°** up to the fuel's max with bellows (Charcoal 1300°, Firewood/Log 900°, wood 700°). 0.5 s between pumps. Pumping at the ceiling (1300°) builds up strain and the kiln can crack. Recipe: `[Planks][Scraped Hide][Planks]` / `[Planks][Scraped Hide][Planks]` / `[Twine][Clay Tuyere][Twine]`.

unfired_clay_tuyere.text: 3 Clay Ball diagonally. Fired into [[clay_tuyere]] in a [[kiln]] (600°).

clay_tuyere.text: Clay pipe for [[bellows]]. Fired from [[unfired_clay_tuyere]] in a [[kiln]] (600°, 20 s).

whetstone.text: Sandstone on a wooden bench. Right-click with a Rough Cast head **4 times** (sparks) to grind it into a head the Tool Station accepts. Recipe: `[ ][Sandstone][ ]` / `[Stick][Planks][Stick]`.

molten_crucible.text: Crucible of Molten Copper / Bronze / Poor Bronze: a [[crucible]] with ore melted in a [[kiln]] (copper 1085°, bronze 950°, 15 s). Pour into a Clay Mold within **60 s**, or it solidifies into a [[solid_crucible]]. Stays molten as long as it sits in a kiln that is hot enough. Molten bronze glows more yellow than copper in the icon.

solid_crucible.text: Crucible of Solid Copper / Bronze: molten metal that solidified before it was poured. Remelted in a [[kiln]] (10 s). Copper can be topped up with more ore; bronze only with Bronze Ingot of the same quality. The icon shows the metal: copper-coloured or bronze-coloured.

copper_knife.text: Tool Station: [[copper_knife_blade]] + Twine + Stick. 200 durability, butchers **1.5×** as fast and yields **1.2×** as much as the [[flint_knife]]. Can't handle bears (the [[tusk_dagger]] can).

raw_phantom_hide.text:
Butchering a Phantom (only if a player killed it), round 1: 60 %.
Raw Phantom Hide + knife → [[scraped_phantom_hide]].

scraped_phantom_hide.text: [[raw_phantom_hide]] + knife (shapeless, the knife loses 1 durability). Hang on a [[drying_rack]]: dries **only in daylight** (day + open sky, ~3 min of sun on average) into [[phantom_leather]]. After ~8 random ticks in darkness (night, rain, indoors; roughly a whole night) it **rots** into Rotten Flesh.

phantom_leather.text: Dried [[scraped_phantom_hide]] from a [[drying_rack]] in daylight. 6 + a [[glider_frame]] are sewn into a [[glider_cloak]] at the [[armor_station]]. Repairs the Glider Cloak.

glider_frame.text: Crafting: 4 [[tool_rod]], 2 Bone, [[sinew]] and [[cordage]] (`RSR / BCB / R R`). The struts for the [[glider_cloak]]. Unlocked by [[phantom_leather]].

glider_cloak.text:
Sewn at the [[armor_station]]: 6 [[phantom_leather]] + [[glider_frame]] with a [[bone_needle]]. Chestplate, armor 1, 96 durability, repaired with Phantom Leather.
**Hold jump while falling** (more than 2 blocks): the fall is slowed (~2.4 m/s) and you glide forward in the direction you're looking (at most ~6 m/s, never upward). No fall damage after a glide, 1 durability per second. Sneak or release jump to let go.

snare.text: 2 Stick + [[cordage]] (crafting). Placed on the ground; a small wild animal that walks into it dies there (80 %) and becomes a Carcass. Right-click with berries/seeds to bait it (attracts within 8 blocks), right-click a sprung snare to reset it. Breaks on 15 % of catches (a Stick is left). Players trip (Slowness); sneak to step over it.

fish_trap.text: 6 Stick + 2 [[twine]] (crafting). Placed in water (at least 12 water blocks around it); catches up to 3 whole fish, fastest in rivers and flowing water. Right-click to empty. Species by biome: salmon in rivers, cod elsewhere, tropical fish in warm oceans.

log_raft.text:
Crafting: 6 logs ([[oak_rough_log]] or another Rough Log, or any Log) lashed with 3 [[cordage]] (`LCL / LCL / LCL`). Unlocked by Cordage.
The Stone Age's first vessel: **1 seat**, slow (~3.4 blocks/s, just under half of a vanilla boat), bobs on the water. Replaces the vanilla boats (disabled until the Bronze Age).

dugout_canoe.text:
Made in the world from a [[dugout_blank]] (no crafting): axe, fire, axe, fire, axe and finally knife.
**2 seats**. With a [[paddle]] in hand ~6.3 blocks/s (87 % of a vanilla boat), without a paddle only ~3.4 blocks/s like the raft. The paddles are only visible while holding a Paddle.

paddle.text:
Any Rough Log + knife (shapeless, the knife loses 1 durability). Unlocked by a Rough Log.
Hold it (in either hand) while sitting in a [[dugout_canoe]]: the canoe goes almost twice as fast.

dugout_blank.text:
**Right-click with a knife** on a Fallen Log (with or without bark, not yet hewn thinner) or a Log lying down: the canoe's outline is scored in (the knife loses 1 durability).
Then: **1** hollow out with an axe (hold right-click, twice as many chops as a Fallen Log step) → **2** light it with a Torch, Fire Drill (75 %) or Flint and Steel, burns 30 s (rain puts it out) → **3** scrape out the charcoal with an axe → **4** burn again → **5** hollow out with an axe → **6** smooth with a knife (4 strokes) → [[dugout_canoe]]. If broken it drops 1–3 Sticks.

smoking_rack.text: 3 Stick + [[cordage]] + 3 Stick (`SCS`/`S S`/`S S`). Hang up to 4 strips of raw meat or raw fish (not mixed). Above (1–2 blocks) or next to a burning/smouldering Campfire, or in a smoky room: after **4 minutes in smoke** they become [[smoked_meat]] / [[smoked_fish]]. Without smoke they spoil as usual (1 day). An empty hand takes everything down.

smoked_meat.text: Raw meat (scraps or vanilla) smoked 4 min on a [[smoking_rack]]. 3 hunger, 0.8 saturation. **Keeps 30 days** (raw meat 1 day).

smoked_fish.text: Raw Cod/Salmon smoked 4 min on a [[smoking_rack]]. 3 hunger, 0.7 saturation. **Keeps 30 days**.

jerky.text: [[raw_meat_strips]] (and meat without a kind of its own) dried in the sun on a [[drying_rack]] (~7–14 min of sunshine). 2 hunger, 0.8 saturation. **Keeps 30 days**.

dried_fish.text: Raw Salmon dried (Raw Cod/Pike/Sturgeon become [[stockfish]]) in the sun on a [[drying_rack]]. 2 hunger, 0.7 saturation. **Keeps 30 days**.

dried_mushrooms.text: 4 edible mushrooms (Chanterelle, Porcini, Morel, Oyster Mushroom, Puffball) dried in the sun on a [[drying_rack]] → 4. 1 hunger, 0.6 saturation. **Keeps 30 days** (fresh mushrooms 2 days).

dried_berries.text: 4 berries (wild or Sweet Berries) dried in the sun on a [[drying_rack]] → 4. 1 hunger, 0.5 saturation. **Keeps 30 days** (fresh berries 2 days).

spoiled_food.text:
What remains of spoiled food that isn't meat or fish (berries, mushrooms, porridge, eggs). Only good for a [[compost_heap]]. Meat and fish rot into Rotten Flesh instead.
Shelf life: raw meat/fish 1 day, berries/mushrooms/porridge 2 days, cooked 3 days, smoked/dried 30 days. The tooltip shows Fresh / Stale / Rotting.

loose_red_ochre.text: A loose lump of red ochre on the ground in Badlands and Savanna (all variants). Picked up by hand: small 1, medium 2 [[red_ochre]].

loose_yellow_ochre.text: A loose lump of yellow ochre on the ground in Savanna, Desert and along rivers (River). Picked up by hand: small 1, medium 2 [[yellow_ochre]].

loose_chalk.text: A loose piece of chalk on the ground at Stony Shore, Beach, Meadow, Windswept Hills / Gravelly Hills and Stony Peaks. Picked up by hand: small 1, medium 2 [[chalk]].

red_ochre.text: From [[loose_red_ochre]]. Ground into [[red_pigment]]: with a Flint Pickaxe in crafting 1 (the pickaxe loses 1 durability), on a [[stone_anvil]] with a hammerstone 2.

yellow_ochre.text: From [[loose_yellow_ochre]]. Ground into [[yellow_pigment]]: with a Flint Pickaxe in crafting 1, on a [[stone_anvil]] 2.

chalk.text: From [[loose_chalk]]. Ground into [[white_pigment]]: with a Flint Pickaxe in crafting 1, on a [[stone_anvil]] 2 (a Calcite block gives 4 on the anvil).

black_pigment.text: Ground Charcoal: Flint Pickaxe in crafting 1, [[stone_anvil]] 2. Black paint ([[black_paint]], [[soot]] also works) and 1 → 1 Black Dye.

white_pigment.text: Ground [[chalk]] or Calcite (only on a [[stone_anvil]]). 2 + binder + Bowl → [[white_paint]]. 1 → 1 White Dye.

black_paint.text: 2 [[black_pigment]] or [[soot]] + Tallow or water (Clay Water Bucket / Water Bucket, the bucket is returned) + Bowl (shapeless). 16 uses, then the bowl is left. Paint with a [[paintbrush]] in the other hand; without a brush you leave a hand print.

red_paint.text: 2 [[red_pigment]] + Tallow or water + Bowl. 16 uses. See [[black_paint]] and [[cave_painting]].

yellow_paint.text: 2 [[yellow_pigment]] + Tallow or water + Bowl. 16 uses. See [[black_paint]] and [[cave_painting]].

white_paint.text: 2 [[white_pigment]] + Tallow or water + Bowl. 16 uses. See [[black_paint]] and [[cave_painting]].

paintbrush.text: Stick + 2 [[plant_fibre]] (shapeless). 64 uses. With paint in the other hand: right-click a block face to paint the selected motif. Sneak + right-click cycles motifs (11, of which 2 are two-block scenes). See [[cave_painting]].

cave_painting.text: Cave painting: a thin layer of paint on a whole block face (wall, ceiling or floor), painted with a [[paintbrush]] and paint. 4 colours × 15 motifs: Aurochs, Horse, Stag, Cave Bear, Mammoth, Ibex, Hunter, Sun, Spiral, Dots, Hand Print (paint without a brush) and two scenes two blocks wide (The Hunt, Running Herd, walls only). Paint over a painting to replace it. Drops nothing when broken; scraped off 4× faster with a knife. Under open sky, rain washes it away over time.

willow_log.text:
New wood type (willow). A branching trunk where each branch carries a flat umbrella of leaves with hanging leaf curtains. Grows near water: River and Swamp, and in Forest, Flower Forest, Birch Forest, Plains and Meadow only next to lakes and streams. Grey furrowed bark, pale planks.
Felled like other trees (the whole tree falls, leaving a [[willow_stump]] and [[willow_fallen_log]]). A broken Log drops 2 [[willow_firewood]]. An axe (right-click) makes a Stripped Willow Log.

willow_planks.text: 1 Willow Log (or Wood/Stripped) → 2 Planks (like all wood types in the Stone Age). Makes Slab, Stairs, Fence, Fence Gate, Door, Trapdoor, Button and Pressure Plate with the usual vanilla recipes.

willow_leaves.text: Leaves of Willow trees. Sometimes drop [[willow_sapling]] and Sticks, like other leaves (no apples). Shears or Silk Touch give the leaf block itself.

willow_sapling.text: Drops from [[willow_leaves]]. Planted on dirt and grows into a Willow tree. Can be put in a Flower Pot.

willow_firewood.text:
All Willow logs (including stripped and wood blocks) drop **2 Willow Firewood** instead of themselves. Felled trees give Firewood via [[willow_fallen_log]] → [[willow_rough_log]] → chop on a stump (2–3).
Builds a [[minecraft:campfire]], fuel in the Clay Kiln (1 min), 2 → Charcoal in the Clay Kiln, and 4 of the same kind → 1 Willow Log. Right-click embers to relight the fire, or a burning fire for +1 minute (max 10 min).
**Woodpile:** right-click the top of a solid block → [[willow_firewood_pile]].
The icon shows 1, 2 or 3 pieces of firewood depending on the count.

willow_rough_log.text:
The last step when working a [[willow_fallen_log]] with an axe (if it succeeds, otherwise 2–3 Sticks). Stacks to 16.
**Right-click a [[willow_stump]]** to set it on the stump (an empty hand takes it back). **Hold right-click with an axe** on it: success → 2–3 [[willow_firewood]] (+1 with Stone Axe, +2 Iron Axe, +3 Diamond Axe), failure → 1 Firewood + 1–2 Sticks. Chance: Flint Axe 60 %, Crude Stone Axe 65 %, Stone Axe 75 %, Iron Axe 95 %.

willow_fallen_log.text:
The trunk of a felled Willow tree is left lying as Fallen Logs where it lands. Has no item.
**Hold right-click with an axe** (one heavy chop every 0.6 s, 4 chops per step with Flint Axe, 3 with Stone Axe, 2 with Iron Axe; the axe loses 1 durability per step): bark off (1–2 [[bark]]) → thinner → thinner still → [[willow_rough_log]] (or just 2–3 Sticks if it fails). Broken normally it drops only 1–2 Sticks.

willow_stump.text:
Left behind where you chopped when a Willow tree is felled. Has no item. Drops 1–2 Sticks, broken fastest with an axe.
Works as a **chopping block**: right-click a [[willow_rough_log]] onto the stump and chop it into Firewood.

willow_wood.text: Willow: bark on all 6 sides, from 4 logs.

potted_willow_sapling.text: Willow: sapling in a Flower Pot.

willow_leaf_litter.text: Fresh leaf litter in the leaves' colour, falls when the tree is felled. Dries into regular Leaf Litter; breaks into regular Leaf Litter (tinder).

pine_resin.text: Pine resin. **Right-click a [[pine_log]] with a knife**: the bark is cut open, 1 Pine Resin, and the log becomes a Stripped Pine Log (once per log, the knife wears 1). 1 Pine Resin over 1 Stick → 2 Torches (resin torch). Used more later (e.g. glue).

bronze_ingot.text: Cast in a [[clay_ingot_mold]] (2 units of bronze). Can be put back into a [[crucible]] (2 units, Poor Bronze stays Poor). Sold to village smiths (level 3).

rough_cast_bronze_pickaxe_head.text: Cast in a [[clay_pickaxe_head_mold]] (6 units of bronze). Ground on a [[whetstone]] (4 strokes) into [[bronze_pickaxe_head]]. If cast from Poor Bronze it carries that mark on (tools/armour get 70 % durability).
