Works as a hammerstone on the [[stone_anvil]].

bronze_axe.text: Tool Station: [[bronze_axe_head]] + [[cordage]] + [[tool_rod]]. Bronze material: **460** durability, speed 6, +2 damage (like iron except durability, iron 250).

bronze_shovel.text: Tool Station: [[bronze_shovel_head]] + [[cordage]] + [[tool_rod]]. Bronze material: **460** durability, speed 6, +2 damage (like iron except durability, iron 250).

bronze_hoe.text: Tool Station: [[bronze_hoe_head]] + [[cordage]] + [[tool_rod]]. Bronze material: **460** durability, speed 6, +2 damage (like iron except durability, iron 250).

bronze_knife.text: Tool Station: [[bronze_knife_blade]] + [[twine]] + Stick. **700** durability, butchers **1.75×** as fast and yields **1.35×** as much as the [[flint_knife]]. **Can handle Brown Bear** (and Giant Deer). Counts as both knife and sword.

bronze_saw.text: Tool Station: [[bronze_saw_blade]] + [[twine]] + Stick. 480 durability. In crafting: **Log + Saw → 4 Planks** (2 without a saw); the saw stays and wears 1.

bronze_helmet.text: [[armor_station]]: 2 [[bronze_plate]] + [[bone_needle]] + 2 Leather. Armour **2**, 110 durability. Iron values but ~70 % of iron's durability. No chestplate or boots in the Bronze Age.

bronze_greaves.text: Shin guards (leggings slot). [[armor_station]]: 3 [[bronze_plate]] + [[bone_needle]] + 3 Leather. Armour **5**, 150 durability. Only visible on the shins. Iron values but ~70 % of iron's durability. No chestplate or boots in the Bronze Age.

clay_saw_blade_mold.text: Fired clay mold (bronze only, 4 units) that gives [[rough_cast_bronze_saw_blade]]. Fired from [[unfired_clay_saw_blade_mold]] in a [[kiln]] (600°). Lasts 5 castings.

clay_plate_mold.text: Fired clay mold (bronze only, 4 units) that gives [[rough_cast_bronze_plate]]. Fired from [[unfired_clay_plate_mold]] in a [[kiln]] (600°). Lasts 5 castings.

unfired_clay_saw_blade_mold.text: Shaped from **5 Clay Balls** at a [[mold_bench]] (no crafting recipe). Fired into a [[clay_saw_blade_mold]] in a [[kiln]] (600°, 20 s).

unfired_clay_plate_mold.text: Shaped from **8 Clay Balls** at a [[mold_bench]] (no crafting recipe). Fired into a [[clay_plate_mold]] in a [[kiln]] (600°, 20 s).

copper_concentrate.text: Washed [[crushed_copper_ore]]: empty [[pan]] with crushed ore in the other hand, hold Use in water for 3 s (the pan wears 1). Counts as **2 units** of copper in a [[crucible]] (crushed ore 1), so washing doubles the yield.

tin_concentrate.text: Washed [[crushed_tin_ore]] (black tin sand): empty [[pan]] with crushed ore in the other hand, hold Use in water for 3 s. **2 units** of tin in a [[crucible]]. Note: 4 Copper Concentrate + 1 Tin Concentrate = 20 % tin, too much; mix with crushed tin (4 + 1 crushed = 11 % = Bronze).

unfired_clay_spear_head_mold.text: Shaped from **4 Clay Balls** at a [[mold_bench]] (no crafting recipe). Fired into a [[clay_spear_head_mold]] in a [[kiln]] (600°, 20 s).

unfired_clay_sword_blade_mold.text: Shaped from **6 Clay Balls** at a [[mold_bench]] (no crafting recipe). Fired into a [[clay_sword_blade_mold]] in a [[kiln]] (600°, 20 s).

clay_spear_head_mold.text: Fired clay mold (bronze only, 4 units) that gives [[rough_cast_bronze_spear_head]]. Fired from [[unfired_clay_spear_head_mold]] in a [[kiln]] (600°). Lasts 5 castings.

clay_sword_blade_mold.text: Fired clay mold (bronze only, 6 units) that gives [[rough_cast_bronze_sword_blade]]. Fired from [[unfired_clay_sword_blade_mold]] in a [[kiln]] (600°). Lasts 5 castings.

rough_cast_bronze_spear_head.text: Cast in a [[clay_spear_head_mold]] (4 units of bronze). Ground on a [[whetstone]] into [[bronze_spear_head]]. Poor Bronze carries over.

rough_cast_bronze_sword_blade.text: Cast in a [[clay_sword_blade_mold]] (6 units of bronze). Ground on a [[whetstone]] into [[bronze_sword_blade]]. Poor Bronze carries over.

bronze_spear_head.text: Ground on a [[whetstone]] from [[rough_cast_bronze_spear_head]]. Assembled in the Tool Station into [[bronze_spear]].

bronze_sword_blade.text: Ground on a [[whetstone]] from [[rough_cast_bronze_sword_blade]] (with crossguard). Assembled in the Tool Station into [[bronze_sword]].

bronze_spear.text: Tool Station: [[bronze_spear_head]] + [[cordage]] + [[tool_rod]]. Vanilla spear (charge and thrust) with iron spear values in bronze: **460** durability, +2 damage, faster and harder-hitting than the [[flint_spear]] (which has stone spear values). Poor Bronze: 70 % durability.

bronze_sword.text: Tool Station: [[bronze_sword_blade]] + [[cordage]] + Leather (grip). Normal sword: **5.5** damage (iron sword 6), 1.6 attack speed, **460** durability. Poor Bronze: 70 % durability.

potters_wheel.text: Recipe: Planks + **Bronze Saw** (stays, wears 1) + Planks / Bronze Ingot / 3 Cobblestone. Sneak + empty hand selects the shape (Storage Jar 4 clay, Water Jug 3 clay), right-click a Clay Ball onto the wheel, hold right-click with an empty hand ~5 s (24 steps) → [[unfired_storage_jar]] / [[unfired_water_jug]].

unfired_storage_jar.text: Thrown on the [[potters_wheel]] from 4 Clay Balls. Fired in the [[kiln]] (30 s, 600°) into a [[storage_jar]].

unfired_water_jug.text: Thrown on the [[potters_wheel]] from 3 Clay Balls. Fired in the [[kiln]] (30 s, 600°) into a [[water_jug]].

storage_jar.text: Fired clay jar with a lid, 9 slots. **Sealed (closed), food ages at 1/4 the normal rate** (Bark Basket 1/3). Hoppers and comparators work.

water_jug.text: Fired clay jug, **6 pours** of water (kept when picked up). Filled in water or by rain; waters farmland 3×3 like the Clay Water Bucket; when placed it fills/empties a Clay Bucket, Bucket and Glass Bottle.

travois.text: 4 [[tool_rod]] + 2 [[cordage]] + [[scraped_hide]] (`R R`/`CHC`/`R R`). Drag sled: place it on the ground, right-click with an empty hand to harness yourself to it; it follows 2.4 blocks behind. Holds **3 room**: a light carcass takes 1, medium 2, large 3 (one large, a medium + a light, or three light; huge ones like the giant deer don't fit). They lie one behind the other. Right-click with the carcass you are carrying or dragging (also on a body already lying on it). Sneak + empty hand unloads. Slows you by 10 % + 7 % per room of load. **Costs food:** 0.02 exhaustion per block empty, up to 0.10 full (sprinting is 0.1). Hit it to pick it up. Follows the ground (gravity, one-block steps) with the poles resting against your hip; when released it lies flat on the ground. If it gets stuck it holds you back 1 block beyond the towing distance, and if you pull away from it for 3 s (or get more than 5 blocks away) you let go.

hanging_rack.text: 5 [[tool_rod]] + [[cordage]] (`RCR`/`R R`/`R R`), two blocks tall. Right-click with a carried or dragged carcass to hang it up. Butchered there it gives the whole hide and **twice as much meat** as [[raw_haunch]], [[raw_ribs]] and [[raw_loin]], plus more fat, sinew and bone; after hanging 3 min ×1.25 meat, and it shows: darker, dried fur or meat, no more blood and the odd fly. A fire within 8 blocks keeps predators away from it. A skinned carcass bleeds onto the ground: a blood pool at the rack's foot that grows in 4 steps and then runs over beside it, until the carcass has aged.

raw_haunch.text: Butchered from a carcass hanging on a [[hanging_rack]] (twice as much meat as on the ground, in large cuts). 3 meat units. Hunger 3. Campfire → [[cooked_haunch]]; on a Smoking Rack it becomes a whole [[smoked_haunch]]; too big to dry whole, knife → 3 [[raw_meat_strips]]. Spoils in 2 days.

raw_ribs.text: Butchered from a carcass hanging on a [[hanging_rack]] (twice as much meat as on the ground, in large cuts). 2 meat units. Hunger 2. Campfire → [[cooked_ribs]]; on a Smoking Rack a whole [[smoked_ribs]]; too big to dry whole, knife → 2 [[raw_meat_strips]]. Spoils in 2 days.

raw_loin.text: Butchered from a carcass hanging on a [[hanging_rack]] (twice as much meat as on the ground, in large cuts). 2 meat units. Hunger 2. Campfire → [[cooked_loin]]; on a Smoking Rack a whole [[smoked_loin]]; too big to dry whole, knife → 2 [[raw_meat_strips]]. Spoils in 2 days.

cooked_haunch.text: [[raw_haunch]] on a Campfire (30 s). Hunger 9, saturation 0.8. Spoils in 3 days.

cooked_ribs.text: [[raw_ribs]] on a Campfire (25 s). Hunger 6, saturation 0.8. Spoils in 3 days.

cooked_loin.text: [[raw_loin]] on a Campfire (25 s). Hunger 6, saturation 1.0. Spoils in 3 days.

wooden_wheel.text: 4 Planks + 3 [[tool_rod]] + [[bronze_ingot]] (hub and linchpin) + [[bronze_saw]], which stays and wears 1 (`PRP`/`RBR`/`PSP`). Spoked wooden wheel, two are needed for a [[cart]].

cart.text: 2 [[wooden_wheel]] + 4 Planks + 2 [[tool_rod]] as shafts (`R R`/`PPP`/`WPW`). The Bronze Age [[travois]]: pull it yourself (right-click with an empty hand, −5 % speed + −3 % per room of load) or harness a tame horse or [[entity:tame_onager]] (right-click while riding or leading it). Holds **6 room** of carcasses (light 1, medium 2, large 3: two large, three medium or six light; huge ones don't fit), lying **side by side** on the bed, and has a storage with **18 slots** (sneak + right-click). **Costs food** when you pull it yourself: 0.01 exhaustion per block empty, up to 0.08 full (300 blocks fully loaded ≈ three drumsticks); a horse pulls for free. **Storage cart:** right-click an empty cart with a Chest to mount it on the bed: **54 slots** (sneak + right-click), but no carcasses. Break the cart and the chest and all its contents drop. Sneak + right-click a carcass to take it off. Hit the cart to pick it up. Tilts around the axle: shafts at the hip of whoever pulls it; parked, it rests with the shafts on the ground. If it gets stuck it resists and comes loose after 3 s of pulling or beyond 5 blocks.

rope_halter.text: 3 [[cordage]] (`C C`/` C `). Halter for a Wild Horse that trusts you (3 trust out of 6, built up by sneaking up and feeding it grain, sheaf, wheat, hay, apple or carrot). The horse is led by the halter; fed up to 6 it becomes tame and can be ridden bareback.

hide_saddle_blanket.text: 3 Leather + 2 [[cordage]] (`LLL`/`C C`). Goes in the tame horse's saddle slot: full speed and full jumps (bareback 80 % speed and 70 % jump).

worn_grass.text: Trampled grass: every step on a Grass Block gives a 5 % chance (not while sneaking). Walking on it again turns it into [[trodden_path]] (10 % per step). **+10 % walking speed.** Grows back into grass if nobody walks there (a couple of days). Hoe: Farmland, shovel: Dirt Path, drops Dirt (Silk Touch: itself).

trodden_path.text: Hard-trodden path: [[worn_grass]], Dirt or Coarse Dirt that has been walked on many times (10 % per step), on average ~30 walks from grass. **+20 % walking speed.** The soil merges with neighbouring paths and frays out towards the grass. Abandoned, it becomes Worn Grass and then grass (~4 days); the world's paths between villages never grow over.

unfired_furnace_brick.text: Fireclay: Clay Ball (C) and Sand (S) in a crafting table `[C][S]` / `[S][C]` gives 4. Fired into [[furnace_brick]] in a [[kiln]] (600°, 10 s).

furnace_brick.text: Fired from [[unfired_furnace_brick]] in a [[kiln]] (600°, 10 s). 4 (2x2) make one [[furnace_bricks]] block.

furnace_bricks.text: The walls of the Smelting Furnace: 4 [[furnace_brick]] (2x2). The furnace is **3x3x3**: 24 Furnace Bricks, a [[furnace_chute]] in the middle of the roof and a [[furnace_tap]] in the middle of the bottom layer's front wall; **only the middle block is empty** (the chamber the melt stands in). Once the furnace is complete, the middle of the bottom row of the side and back walls shows a fired-clay **blowpipe hole (tuyere)** that glows while the furnace burns: that is where [[bellows]] belong (they work against any wall). Mined with a pickaxe and always drops plain Furnace Bricks.

furnace_tap.text: The Smelting Furnace's control block: [[furnace_bricks]] + [[clay_channel]] + Clay Ball + Stick (shapeless). Placed in the middle of the bottom layer's front wall with the spout facing out. Throw **ore, ingots and Charcoal** onto the [[furnace_chute]] (holds **40 units** of metal, 16 Charcoal; tin at most 4.5 units and copper without tin at most 35.5, so the other ore always fits), light it with a [[fire_drill]] on the tap and pump with [[bellows]] against a wall (bronze 950°, copper 1085°). The fire shows in the fire mouth above the tap hole. Ore gives **25 % more metal** than in a [[crucible]]; copper and tin become bronze directly in the furnace (same mixing rules, Poor Bronze). **Right-click:** status GUI with every metal, its amount and quality (or what is missing). **Sneak + right-click:** pulls/inserts the plug. An open tap fills a Clay Mold right in front of the spout, or pours into [[clay_channel]]s where the metal runs downhill and fills molds. If the tap is broken the melt is lost (the fuel falls out).

unfired_clay_channel.text: Clay Ball (C) in a crafting table: `[C][ ][C]` / `[C][ ][C]` gives 4. Fired into [[clay_channel]] in a [[kiln]] (600°, 20 s).

clay_channel.text: Fired clay channel (from [[unfired_clay_channel]] in a [[kiln]]). Connects to channels, Clay Molds and a [[furnace_tap]]'s spout next to it (straight, corner, T, cross). **Slopes like rails:** placed one block below a channel (or a spout) beside it, with no level channel on that side, it becomes a 45° slope joining the two levels. The channel **holds metal** (1 unit each): from an open tap the metal runs channel by channel, downhill first, then along level runs away from the tap, so the network fills from its low and far ends; an empty mold beside a channel fills once the metal reaching it (plus what the tap can still pour) is enough. Metal that stands still for **60 s sets**. **An empty [[crucible]] on a channel** scoops whole units (up to 10) out of the network: molten → Crucible of Molten Metal, set → Crucible of Solid Metal. Breaking a channel with metal in it spills the metal and it is lost.

raw_goose.text: The second pass when butchering a plucked Greylag Goose Carcass with a knife (2), or [[plucked_goose]] + knife in the crafting grid. Hunger 3, 30 % chance of Hunger like raw chicken. Campfire (20 s) → [[cooked_goose]]; can be smoked ([[smoked_meat]]) and dried ([[jerky]]). Spoils in 1 day.

cooked_goose.text: [[raw_goose]] on a Campfire (20 s), or a whole [[plucked_goose]] (30 s, gives 2). Hunger 7, saturation 0.8. Spoils in 3 days.

raw_pheasant.text: The second pass when butchering a plucked Pheasant Carcass with a knife (1), or [[plucked_pheasant]] + knife in the crafting grid. Hunger 2, 30 % chance of Hunger like raw chicken. Campfire (20 s) → [[cooked_pheasant]]; can be smoked ([[smoked_meat]]) and dried ([[jerky]]). Spoils in 1 day.

cooked_pheasant.text: [[raw_pheasant]] on a Campfire (20 s), or a whole [[plucked_pheasant]] (30 s, gives 1). Hunger 6, saturation 0.7. Spoils in 3 days.

raw_ptarmigan.text: The second pass when butchering a plucked Willow Ptarmigan Carcass with a knife (1), or [[plucked_ptarmigan]] + knife in the crafting grid. Hunger 2, 30 % chance of Hunger like raw chicken. Campfire (20 s) → [[cooked_ptarmigan]]; can be smoked ([[smoked_meat]]) and dried ([[jerky]]). Spoils in 1 day.

cooked_ptarmigan.text: [[raw_ptarmigan]] on a Campfire (20 s), or a whole [[plucked_ptarmigan]] (30 s, gives 1). Hunger 5, saturation 0.7. Spoils in 3 days.

raw_pigeon.text: The second pass when butchering a plucked Rock Dove Carcass with a knife (1), or [[plucked_pigeon]] + knife in the crafting grid. Hunger 1, 30 % chance of Hunger like raw chicken. Campfire (20 s) → [[cooked_pigeon]]; can be smoked ([[smoked_meat]]) and dried ([[jerky]]). Spoils in 1 day.

cooked_pigeon.text: [[raw_pigeon]] on a Campfire (20 s), or a whole [[plucked_pigeon]] (30 s, gives 1). Hunger 4, saturation 0.6. Spoils in 3 days.

plucked_goose.text: Right-click with an **empty hand** on a plucked Greylag Goose Carcass (after the knife) to take the bird whole. Stacks to 16, spoils in 1 day. + knife in the crafting grid → 2 [[raw_goose]]; whole on a Campfire (30 s) → 2 [[cooked_goose]]. Boiled whole in a [[bronze_kettle]]: 2 [[broth]] and the bird comes out cooked.

plucked_pheasant.text: Right-click with an **empty hand** on a plucked Pheasant Carcass (after the knife) to take the bird whole. Stacks to 16, spoils in 1 day. + knife in the crafting grid → [[raw_pheasant]]; whole on a Campfire (30 s) → [[cooked_pheasant]]. Boiled whole in a [[bronze_kettle]]: 2 [[broth]] and the bird comes out cooked.

plucked_ptarmigan.text: Right-click with an **empty hand** on a plucked Willow Ptarmigan Carcass (after the knife) to take the bird whole. Stacks to 16, spoils in 1 day. + knife in the crafting grid → [[raw_ptarmigan]]; whole on a Campfire (30 s) → [[cooked_ptarmigan]]. Boiled whole in a [[bronze_kettle]]: 2 [[broth]] and the bird comes out cooked.

plucked_pigeon.text: Right-click with an **empty hand** on a plucked Rock Dove Carcass (after the knife) to take the bird whole. Stacks to 16, spoils in 1 day. + knife in the crafting grid → [[raw_pigeon]]; whole on a Campfire (30 s) → [[cooked_pigeon]]. Boiled whole in a [[bronze_kettle]]: 2 [[broth]] and the bird comes out cooked.

plucked_chicken.text: Right-click with an **empty hand** on a plucked Chicken Carcass (after the knife) to take the bird whole. Stacks to 16, spoils in 1 day. + knife in the crafting grid → Raw Chicken; whole on a Campfire (30 s) → Cooked Chicken. Boiled whole in a [[bronze_kettle]]: 2 [[broth]] and the bird comes out cooked.

goose_egg.text: A large cream-white egg that the Greylag Goose lays in its [[bird_nest]]. Take it with an empty hand (leave one, or the birds may abandon the nest). Not edible raw, does not hatch. Campfire (15 s) → 2 [[boiled_egg]]. Does not spoil.

pheasant_egg.text: An olive-brown egg that the Pheasant lays in its [[bird_nest]]. Take it with an empty hand (leave one, or the birds may abandon the nest). Not edible raw, does not hatch. Campfire (15 s) → [[boiled_egg]]. Does not spoil.

ptarmigan_egg.text: A speckled egg that the Willow Ptarmigan lays in its [[bird_nest]]. Take it with an empty hand (leave one, or the birds may abandon the nest). Not edible raw, does not hatch. Campfire (15 s) → [[boiled_egg]]. Does not spoil.

pigeon_egg.text: A small white egg that the Rock Dove lays in its [[bird_nest]]. Take it with an empty hand (leave one, or the birds may abandon the nest). Not edible raw, does not hatch. Campfire (15 s) → [[boiled_egg]]. Does not spoil.

bird_nest.text: A nest of twigs lined with straw and down. Found in the wild where the birds live (Greylag Goose by water, Pheasant in forests, Willow Ptarmigan on snow and in taiga, Rock Dove on bare cliffs) or built from 3 Stick + 2 Straw/Plant Fibre (`S S`/`WSW`). An empty nest is taken over by the first nesting bird within 12 blocks (Chicken too). The birds stay around the nest and lay eggs (up to 3, roughly one every 7 minutes while one of them is nearby). Right-click with an empty hand to take an egg. **If the nest is emptied 3 times** before the birds have calmed down (one step roughly per hour), they abandon it; an abandoned nest can be taken over again after about a day. Drops itself and the eggs.

tripod.text: 3 [[tool_rod]] + [[cordage]] (` C `/` R `/`R R`). Placed on top of a Campfire or a [[fire_pit]]; over a pit it stands centred over the whole 2×2, one per pit. Right-click with a [[bronze_kettle]] to hang it. The fire heats it: lit Campfire 1×, lit Fire Pit 1.5×, embers only keep it warm. Falls if the fire is removed. Broken: tripod and kettle drop, the contents spill.

bronze_kettle.text: [[rough_cast_bronze_kettle]] ground on the [[whetstone]]. Hangs in a [[tripod]]. Fill with a water bucket or [[clay_water_bucket]] (wears 1), add up to 8 things (Poor Bronze: 6). The first thing in sets the mode: food → [[stew]] (only plucked birds → [[broth]] + boiled birds), Lard/Bear Fat/Bone → [[tallow]], Raw Hide/Rabbit Hide/Fish Bones → [[hide_glue]], Bark + [[scraped_hide]] → Leather. Simmers 90 s over a Campfire (60 s over a Fire Pit), rendering 2 min, tanning 3 min. Empty hand: take out what's done, else show status. Sneak + empty hand: pour out; an empty kettle is taken down.

rough_cast_bronze_kettle.text: Cast in a [[clay_kettle_mold]] (8 units of bronze). Ground on the [[whetstone]] into a [[bronze_kettle]]. Poor Bronze carries over (holds 6 instead of 8).

clay_kettle_mold.text: Fired clay mold, bronze only, 8 units; gives a [[rough_cast_bronze_kettle]]. Filled from a crucible or through Clay Channels from a Smelting Furnace ([[furnace_tap]]). Fired from an [[unfired_clay_kettle_mold]] in the [[kiln]] (600°). Lasts 5 casts.

unfired_clay_kettle_mold.text: Shaped from **28 Clay Balls** (as much clay as 7 Clay blocks) at a [[mold_bench]]. Fired in the [[kiln]] into a [[clay_kettle_mold]].

stew.text: Ladled from a [[bronze_kettle]] with a Bowl. Value = the ingredients' cooked hunger and saturation (what each becomes on a Campfire) × (1.25 + 0.05 per different ingredient, max 1.5), split into up to 6 bowls of about 7 hunger each. Example: 2 Raw Beef + 2 Carrot + 1 Potato (27 if roasted) → 5 bowls of 7 hunger and 10.5 saturation. The tooltip lists the ingredients. Spoils in 1 day; the bowl comes back.

broth.text: Made by boiling only whole plucked birds ([[plucked_goose]] etc.) in a [[bronze_kettle]]: 2 bowls per bird (max 8), and the birds come out cooked. 4 hunger. Spoils in 1 day.

hide_glue.text: Boiled in a [[bronze_kettle]]: [[raw_hide]] → 3, Rabbit Hide → 1, 2 [[fish_bones]] → 1. Binds like [[cordage]] at the [[tool_station]], in the [[sinew_bow]] and in [[bellows]] (instead of Twine).

entity:woolly_mammoth.text: Rare herd (2–4) on the cold steppe, led by a bigger **matriarch** (220 hp, boss bar). Warns with a trumpet blast, charges whoever comes closer; hurt one and every grown mammoth attacks. Sweeps with trunk and tusks: hits everything in a wide arc in front and throws it far. Only flees at 20 % hp. The carcass is too big to hang. Always gives 2 [[mammoth_ivory]]. See docs/fauna/giants.md.

entity:woolly_rhino.text: Solitary grazer of the cold steppe, short-sighted. Hurt, it paws the ground and **charges** straight ahead (9 damage, tosses the target); step aside, and if it runs into a wall it stands dazed. Gives [[rhino_horn]] and [[raw_rhino_hide]].

entity:steppe_bison.text: Herds on plains, savanna and cold steppe. Bulls charge when hurt; a panicked herd **stampedes** and tramples whatever stands in its way. Gives [[raw_bison_hide]] and [[bison_tongue]].

entity:musk_ox.text: Herds on snow. Threatened, the herd doesn't run but closes into a **ring**, horns out and calves in the middle; the ox nearest the threat makes short charges. Gives [[qiviut]] and [[raw_musk_ox_hide]].

raw_mammoth.text: From a [[woolly_mammoth]] (8–12 per carcass). Campfire or smoker → [[cooked_mammoth]]. Spoils in 1 day, can be smoked/dried.

cooked_mammoth.text: Cooked mammoth meat: 4 hunger, saturation 0.8. Spoils in 3 days.

cooked_bison.text: Cooked bison meat: 3 hunger, high saturation 0.9.

bison_tongue.text: The hunters' prize cut, 80 % chance from a [[steppe_bison]]. Roasts into [[cooked_bison_tongue]].

cooked_musk_ox.text: Cooked musk ox meat: 3 hunger, saturation 0.8.

raw_mammoth_hide.text: Raw hide from a [[woolly_mammoth]]. Too big for a Drying Rack: **place it on the ground** to peg it out; it cures in the sun (~13 min) into [[mammoth_hide]]. An empty hand takes the finished hide.

raw_rhino_hide.text: Raw hide from a [[woolly_rhino]]. Place it on the ground; cures in the sun (~9 min) into [[rhino_hide]].

raw_bison_hide.text: Raw hide from a [[steppe_bison]]. Place it on the ground; cures in the sun (~8 min) into [[bison_hide]].

raw_musk_ox_hide.text: Raw hide from a [[musk_ox]]. Place it on the ground; cures in the sun (~7 min) into [[musk_ox_hide]].

mammoth_hide.text: Cured mammoth hide. [[mammoth_rug]] (with [[mammoth_wool]]) or 4 Leather with a knife.

rhino_hide.text: Thick cured rhino hide. **Shield** (Planks–Hide–Planks / 3 Planks / Planks) or 3 Leather with a knife.

bison_hide.text: Cured bison hide. [[bison_rug]] (with [[horn]]) or 3 Leather with a knife.

musk_ox_hide.text: Cured musk ox hide. [[musk_ox_rug]] (with [[qiviut]]) or 2 Leather with a knife.

mammoth_ivory.text: Always 2 from a [[woolly_mammoth]]; sometimes in Mammoth Bone Huts. Becomes the [[ivory_knife]] and [[ivory_figurine]].

mammoth_wool.text: Long hair from a [[woolly_mammoth]] (first butchering pass). 1 → 2 [[twine]], 4 → Brown Wool.

mammoth_fat.text: From a [[woolly_mammoth]]. Renders on a Campfire into 3 [[tallow]].

rhino_horn.text: From a [[woolly_rhino]]. Becomes the [[rhino_horn_club]], or 2 [[bone_needle]] with a knife.

qiviut.text: The musk ox's fine underwool, first butchering pass. 1 → 2 [[wool_thread]], 4 → Light Gray Wool.

ivory_knife.text: Crafting: [[walrus_ivory]] (`[I][ ]` / `[T][S]` with Twine and a Stick, like the Flint Knife). A knife like the [[tusk_dagger]]: 1.3× faster, 1.1× more meat, 1.3× more hide, 180 durability; **cuts thick hides** (bear, walrus). Can also be made from [[mammoth_ivory]] + [[cordage]] + Leather (I/C/L).

rhino_horn_club.text: Crafting: [[rhino_horn]] over [[cordage]] over [[tool_rod]]. A heavy, slow club, 240 durability.

ivory_figurine.text: [[mammoth_ivory]] + knife. A little carved mammoth to set on a table. Decoration.

mold_bench.text: Crafting: Flint, Clay (block), Flint / Planks ×3. Unlocks when you carry a Clay Ball. Right-click to open. Like the Armor Station: pick a mold in the list on the left and the clay is pulled from your inventory (shift-click: as many sets as fit), then take the result. The [[unfired_crucible]] and every clay mold are shaped here from Clay Balls only: Ingot 5, Pickaxe/Axe Head 7, Shovel Head 5, Hoe Head 6, Knife Blade 4, Saw Blade 5, Plate 8, Spear Head 4, Sword Blade 6, Kettle 28. When several molds cost the same, the one you picked wins. Mined with an axe.

entity:mallard.text: Mallard by rivers, lakes and swamps (also Willow Fen; on water and banks in plains and forests). Flocks of 3–6, swims and tips up to dabble (head under water). Drake with a green head, hen mottled brown. Springs straight up off the water when a player comes close. 5 HP, one arrow kills. Carcass: pluck (1–2 feathers, 60 % [[down]]), butcher into 1 [[raw_mallard]] or take [[plucked_mallard]] whole. Caught in snares. Nests in [[bird_nest]] by the water and lays [[mallard_egg]].

entity:mute_swan.text: Mute swan, pairs on rivers, in swamps and Willow Fen (on water only). Calm, lets you come closer than other birds, flies in lines. **Defends its nest:** come within 6 blocks of a [[bird_nest]] it claimed and it hisses and attacks (3 damage per bite) until you are 12 blocks away; hit near the nest it fights instead of flying off. 16 HP. Carcass: pluck (3–5 feathers, 2–3 [[down]], 80 % 1–2 [[swan_quill]]), butcher into 3–4 [[raw_swan]] + 60 % [[hollow_bird_bone]], or take [[plucked_swan]] whole. Lays [[swan_egg]].

entity:grey_heron.text: Grey heron, alone by rivers, in swamps, mangroves, Willow Fen and sometimes on beaches. Wades into shallow water and stands still; when a fish comes within reach it spears it with a lightning thrust (the fish is gone). Flies with the neck folded back and legs trailing, can perch in trees. Wary. 8 HP. Carcass: pluck (2–3 feathers, 90 % 1–2 [[heron_plume]]), butcher into 1–2 [[raw_heron]] + 80 % [[heron_bill]], or take [[plucked_heron]] whole. Lays [[heron_egg]].

entity:common_crane.text: Common crane in flocks of 3–6 in Willow Fen, swamps, Pine Heath, plains and meadows. Forages on the ground and wades in shallow water, very shy. Flies high in V formation and moves on: now and then the leader takes the flock 64–128 blocks away. Two cranes on the ground sometimes dance: wings half open, bowing and leaping. 12 HP. Carcass: pluck (3–4 feathers), butcher into 2–3 [[raw_crane]] + 80 % 1–2 [[hollow_bird_bone]], or take [[plucked_crane]] whole. Lays [[crane_egg]].

raw_mallard.text: From a plucked Mallard Carcass, or [[plucked_mallard]] + knife. Hunger 2, chance of Hunger raw. Campfire (20 s) → [[cooked_mallard]]; can be smoked and dried. Spoils in 1 day.

cooked_mallard.text: [[raw_mallard]] on a Campfire (20 s) or a whole [[plucked_mallard]] (30 s). Hunger 6, saturation 0.7. Spoils in 3 days.

plucked_mallard.text: Empty hand on a plucked Mallard Carcass. Stacks to 16, spoils in 1 day. + knife → [[raw_mallard]]; whole on a Campfire → [[cooked_mallard]]; boils into [[broth]] in a [[bronze_kettle]].

mallard_egg.text: Greenish egg from the mallard's [[bird_nest]]. Campfire (15 s) → [[boiled_egg]].

raw_swan.text: From a plucked Mute Swan Carcass (3–4), or [[plucked_swan]] + knife (3). Hunger 3. Campfire (20 s) → [[cooked_swan]]; can be smoked and dried. Spoils in 1 day.

cooked_swan.text: [[raw_swan]] on a Campfire (20 s), or a whole [[plucked_swan]] (30 s, gives 3). Hunger 8, saturation 0.8. Spoils in 3 days.

plucked_swan.text: Empty hand on a plucked Mute Swan Carcass. Stacks to 8, spoils in 1 day. + knife → 3 [[raw_swan]]; whole on a Campfire → 3 [[cooked_swan]]; boils into [[broth]].

swan_egg.text: A very large chalky-white egg from the swan's [[bird_nest]] – mind the swan. Campfire (15 s) → 3 [[boiled_egg]].

raw_heron.text: From a plucked Grey Heron Carcass (1–2), or [[plucked_heron]] + knife. Dark meat, hunger 2. Campfire → [[cooked_heron]]; can be smoked and dried. Spoils in 1 day.

cooked_heron.text: [[raw_heron]] on a Campfire (20 s) or a whole [[plucked_heron]]. Hunger 5, saturation 0.6. Spoils in 3 days.

plucked_heron.text: Empty hand on a plucked Grey Heron Carcass. Stacks to 16. + knife → [[raw_heron]]; whole on a Campfire → [[cooked_heron]]; boils into [[broth]].

heron_egg.text: Pale blue-green egg from the heron's [[bird_nest]]. Campfire (15 s) → [[boiled_egg]].

raw_crane.text: From a plucked Common Crane Carcass (2–3), or [[plucked_crane]] + knife (2). Hunger 3. Campfire → [[cooked_crane]]; can be smoked and dried. Spoils in 1 day.

cooked_crane.text: [[raw_crane]] on a Campfire (20 s), or a whole [[plucked_crane]] (30 s, gives 2). Hunger 7, saturation 0.8. Spoils in 3 days.

plucked_crane.text: Empty hand on a plucked Common Crane Carcass. Stacks to 8. + knife → 2 [[raw_crane]]; whole on a Campfire → 2 [[cooked_crane]]; boils into [[broth]].

crane_egg.text: Olive-brown, blotched egg from the crane's [[bird_nest]]. Campfire (15 s) → 2 [[boiled_egg]].

down.text: Down plucked from Mallard (60 %) and Mute Swan (2–3). **Tinder:** right-click an unlit Campfire, [[fire_pit]] or kiln with it, like Leaf Litter or Bark. Lines the [[plume_headdress]].

swan_quill.text: Large white flight feather from the Mute Swan. + knife → 4 Feathers (for arrows at the Fletching Table). Can replace the middle plume of the [[plume_headdress]].

heron_plume.text: The grey heron's long black-grey nape plumes. For the [[plume_headdress]], and repairs it.

heron_bill.text: The grey heron's dagger bill. + knife → 2 [[bone_fish_hook]].

hollow_bird_bone.text: Hollow wing bone from the Mute Swan and Common Crane. + knife → [[bone_flute]]; + Flint → 2 [[bone_needle]].

bone_flute.text: A flute of a hollow bird bone ([[hollow_bird_bone]] + knife), like the oldest flutes ever found. Right-click plays a phrase on a five-note scale (3 s cooldown). The music lifts the spirits: every player within 12 blocks gains +3 sanity, up to 75. Can also be carved from a [[vulture_wing_bone]] with a knife.

plume_headdress.text: A leather band with heron plumes: 2 [[heron_plume]] + [[swan_quill]] (or a third plume) on top, Leather + [[down]] + Leather below. Helmet with 1 armor. **Grey herons and cranes don't notice the wearer until within 4 blocks** (unless already scared). Repaired with [[heron_plume]].

raw_capercaillie.text: From a plucked [[entity:capercaillie]] carcass (1–2) or [[plucked_capercaillie]] + knife (2). Dark game meat. Cooks on a Campfire (20 s) or in the smoker into [[cooked_capercaillie]]. Spoils in 1 day; can be dried and smoked.

cooked_capercaillie.text: Cooked [[raw_capercaillie]], or a whole [[plucked_capercaillie]] roasted on a Campfire (2). 7 hunger. Spoils in 3 days.

plucked_capercaillie.text: Pluck a capercaillie carcass with a knife and take the bird whole with an empty hand. Knife in the grid → 2 [[raw_capercaillie]], whole on a Campfire → 2 [[cooked_capercaillie]]. Spoils in 1 day.

capercaillie_egg.text: Taken from a [[bird_nest]] on the pine-forest floor (taiga, Pine Heath) claimed by a [[entity:capercaillie]]. Boils on a Campfire into 1 Boiled Egg.

capercaillie_tail_feather.text: First round of butchering a [[entity:capercaillie]] (60 %, 1–2). The broad tail feather fletches more arrows: Fletching Table Flint + Stick + Capercaillie Tail Feather → **6** Arrows (a plain Feather gives 4).

raw_bustard.text: From a plucked [[entity:great_bustard]] carcass (2–3) or [[plucked_bustard]] + knife (3). Cooks on a Campfire or in the smoker into [[cooked_bustard]]. Spoils in 1 day; can be dried and smoked.

cooked_bustard.text: Cooked [[raw_bustard]], or a whole [[plucked_bustard]] on a Campfire (3, 35 s). 8 hunger. Spoils in 3 days.

plucked_bustard.text: Pluck a bustard carcass and take it whole. Knife in the grid → 3 [[raw_bustard]], whole on a Campfire → 3 [[cooked_bustard]].

bustard_egg.text: Big olive-green egg from a [[bird_nest]] in the grass of the plains claimed by a [[entity:great_bustard]]. Boils on a Campfire into **2** Boiled Eggs.

owl_feather.text: Dropped by an [[entity:owl]] (1–3). Soft, with a fringed edge that makes its flight silent. Fletching Table: Flint + Stick + Owl Feather → 4 [[silent_arrow]].

owl_pellet.text: A coughed-up ball of fur and tiny bones an [[entity:owl]] drops under its day roost now and then. A sign an owl lives here. In the grid → 2 Bone Meal.

raven_feather.text: Dropped by a [[entity:raven]] (1–3). Glossy black. Three of them make a [[raven_talisman]].

raven_talisman.text: Crafting: Twine on top, 3 [[raven_feather]] in the middle, Bone below. **Carried in the inventory:** 40 % of the sanity the dark takes each second comes back, so darkness wears on you more slowly. Does not help against sudden scares.

eagle_feather.text: Dropped by a [[entity:golden_eagle]] (1–3). Big and stiff: Fletching Table Flint + Stick + Eagle Feather → 4 [[eagle_fletched_arrow]].

eagle_talon.text: Dropped by a [[entity:golden_eagle]] (0–2). Can stand in for the Bear Claw as the tip of a [[barbed_arrow]] at the Fletching Table.

vulture_wing_bone.text: Always dropped by a [[entity:vulture]]. Hollow and light; carved into a [[bone_flute]] with a knife.

eagle_fletched_arrow.text: Fletching Table: Flint + Stick + [[eagle_feather]] → 4. **2.75 damage** (regular arrow 2): the hardest-hitting flint arrow.

silent_arrow.text: Fletching Table: Flint + Stick + [[owl_feather]] → 4. 2 damage. **A miss lands without a sound:** animals around the impact are not startled (regular arrows hitting ground or trees make everything within 12 blocks flee).

entity:capercaillie.text: Capercaillie in taiga, old pine forests and Pine Heath (1–3). The cock is slate grey with a green breast, the hen smaller and brown. Bursts up with a clatter, flies low and short, roosts in the pines. **Lek at dawn:** the cock fans his tail and sings (clicks, a pop, the grind); **while he grinds he hears nothing** and you can sneak up. Leaves a Carcass: pluck it (2–4 Feathers, 60 % [[capercaillie_tail_feather]]) and butcher it into [[raw_capercaillie]], or take [[plucked_capercaillie]] whole. Nests on the ground in a [[bird_nest]] ([[capercaillie_egg]]).

entity:great_bustard.text: Great bustard on plains, savanna and Hazel Meadow (2–4). The wariest of all: **runs** off from far away and only flies (heavily and short) when you get close, when it is hit or when the drove is shot at. Leaves a Carcass with a lot of meat: pluck it (3–5 Feathers) and butcher it into 2–3 [[raw_bustard]], or take [[plucked_bustard]] whole. Nests in a [[bird_nest]] in the grass ([[bustard_egg]]).

entity:owl.text: Eagle-owl in forests and taiga (alone). Dozes on a branch by day (now and then leaving an [[owl_pellet]]) and hunts at night, **completely silent**. Strikes small game (squirrel, hare, rabbit, hedgehog, ptarmigan) and leaves the kill as a carcass. Its deep hooting in the dark wears on an already uneasy mind (−1 Sanity below 70). No carcass: drops Feathers and 1–3 [[owl_feather]].

entity:raven.text: Raven in forests and mountains (2–3). Wary and clever: **follows hunters** (players holding a bow or spear) and wheels high over them, gathers round carcasses and **steals scraps of meat** off the ground (shoot the thief and it drops its loot). No carcass: drops 1–3 [[raven_feather]].

entity:golden_eagle.text: Golden eagle in the mountains (1–2). Soars high and stoops on hares, ptarmigans, squirrels and foxes, kills the prey and feeds at it for 30 s. **Steals small game** a hunter just shot: grabs the carcass and flies off with it (shoot it down and the body falls). Scare it off its meal and the carcass stays. No carcass: drops Feathers, 1–3 [[eagle_feather]] and 0–2 [[eagle_talon]].

entity:vulture.text: Griffon vulture on savanna, badlands and windswept hills (2–4). Soars very high; seeing a carcass within 80 blocks **the whole group circles over it**, a sign of meat from far off, and night predators within 96 blocks head there. After half a minute they land and feed: left alone, only a bone pile remains. No carcass: drops 2–4 Feathers and a [[vulture_wing_bone]].

entity:seal.text: Seal in groups (2–5) on snowy beaches, stony shores and the ice floes of frozen oceans (a few on ordinary beaches). Basks with head and tail raised, sleeps on land at night. **Slips into the water** as soon as someone comes close (sneak!), dives and swims fast, holds its breath for 5 minutes. 16 health. Pups are white. Leaves a Carcass: [[raw_sealskin]], [[raw_seal_meat]] (2–3), [[blubber]] and sometimes Sinew.

entity:walrus.text: Walrus in herds (2–4) on ice floes and snowy beaches. **Hardly afraid:** bellows and rears its tusks at anyone who comes close, and **fights back** when hurt (8 damage; the whole herd defends a hurt calf). Flees to the water only when badly bleeding. 60 health. **Thick hide:** needs a [[tusk_dagger]], [[ivory_knife]] or better knife. Too big for the Hanging Rack and the travois. Gives [[walrus_ivory]] (2), [[raw_walrus_hide]], [[raw_walrus_meat]] (4–6), [[blubber]] (2–4), Sinew and Bone.

entity:pike.text: Pike in rivers, frozen rivers, swamps and the Willow Fen (rarely in forest lakes). **Ambush hunter:** hangs almost still, then darts at small fish (cod, salmon …) and swallows them whole; fed, it rests a while. Flees from anyone who doesn't sneak. 8 health. Dies as a [[whole_pike]]. Also bites on the hook in the same waters.

entity:sturgeon.text: Sturgeon: a rare, huge armoured fish of the rivers (always alone). Cruises slowly along the bottom and now and then leaps out of the water. 30 health. **Leaves a Carcass** (dragged, not carried): 4–6 [[raw_sturgeon]], sometimes Raw Hide, [[sturgeon_roe]], always [[isinglass]], Fish Bones. On the Hanging Rack its meat doesn't become cuts, it only gains a piece once aged. A young sturgeon can bite on the hook: [[whole_sturgeon]].

raw_seal_meat.text: From a butchered [[entity:seal]] (2–3). 3 hunger (may give Hunger raw). Cooked on a Campfire or in the smoker into [[cooked_seal_meat]]; can be smoked and dried. Spoils in 1 day.

cooked_seal_meat.text: Cooked [[raw_seal_meat]]: 7 hunger, 0.8 saturation. Spoils in 3 days.

blubber.text: Fat from the [[entity:seal]] (0.9 chance, 1–3) and the [[entity:walrus]] (always 2–4). **Fuel for the [[oil_lamp]]** (one fill per piece, ~7 minutes of light).

raw_sealskin.text: First round when butchering an [[entity:seal]] (always 1). Must be dried on a **tall** [[drying_rack]], where it takes **one half** (like a wolf pelt): ~6 min in sunlight without rain → [[sealskin]].

sealskin.text: Dried [[raw_sealskin]]. Sewn at the [[armor_station]] with a Bone Needle and Sinew: [[sealskin_parka]] (4 + 3 Sinew) and [[sealskin_boots]] (2 + 1 Sinew).

sealskin_parka.text: Armor Station: 4 [[sealskin]], Bone Needle, 3 Sinew. 3 armor. **Warm:** keeps out 20 % of the cold. **Waterproof:** keeps out 35 % of the chill of being in water (the boots as much again).

sealskin_boots.text: Armor Station: 2 [[sealskin]], Bone Needle, Sinew. 1 armor, keeps out 20 % of the cold and 35 % of the water's chill.

raw_walrus_meat.text: From a butchered [[entity:walrus]] (4–6). 3 hunger (may give Hunger raw). Cooked into [[cooked_walrus_meat]]; can be smoked and dried. Spoils in 1 day.

cooked_walrus_meat.text: Cooked [[raw_walrus_meat]]: 8 hunger, 0.8 saturation. Spoils in 3 days.

walrus_ivory.text: Both tusks of a butchered [[entity:walrus]] (always 2). Crafting: Ivory + Twine + Stick → [[ivory_knife]]; with a knife → 2 [[bone_needle]] or 3 [[bone_fish_hook]]. Repairs the Ivory Knife.

raw_walrus_hide.text: First round when butchering a [[entity:walrus]] (always 1). Must be dried on a **tall** [[drying_rack]], where it takes **the whole rack** (like the bear pelt) → [[walrus_hide]].

walrus_hide.text: Dried [[raw_walrus_hide]]. **With a knife → 6 [[cordage]]** (walrus-hide rope, the strongest rope there is). Armor Station: 2 Walrus Hide + 4 Sinew → [[walrus_hide_cuirass]].

walrus_hide_cuirass.text: Armor Station: 2 [[walrus_hide]], Bone Needle, 4 Sinew. A chest piece of layered hide as the arctic hunters wore it: **5 armor, 1 toughness**, 5 % knockback resistance, but no warmth.

whole_pike.text: A whole pike: from a killed [[entity:pike]] or fished in rivers, frozen rivers, swamps and the Willow Fen. Gutted with a knife in the crafting grid → 2 [[raw_pike]] + Fish Bones. Spoils in 1 day.

raw_pike.text: Pike fillet from a gutted [[whole_pike]]. 2 hunger. Cooked into [[cooked_pike]]; can be smoked or dried like fish. Spoils in 1 day.

cooked_pike.text: Cooked [[raw_pike]]: 6 hunger, 0.8 saturation. Spoils in 3 days.

whole_sturgeon.text: A young sturgeon that took the hook in a river (rare). Gutted with a knife → 2 [[raw_sturgeon]] + Fish Bones + [[isinglass]], and a 40 % chance of [[sturgeon_roe]]. Spoils in 1 day.

raw_sturgeon.text: Sturgeon meat from an [[entity:sturgeon]] or a gutted [[whole_sturgeon]]. 2 hunger. Cooked into [[cooked_sturgeon]]; can be smoked or dried like fish. Spoils in 1 day.

cooked_sturgeon.text: Cooked [[raw_sturgeon]]: 7 hunger, 0.9 saturation. Spoils in 3 days.

sturgeon_roe.text: Sturgeon roe (caviar) from a butchered [[entity:sturgeon]] (0.6 chance, 1–3) or a gutted [[whole_sturgeon]]. Eaten raw and fast: 3 hunger, **1.2 saturation**. Spoils in 1 day.

isinglass.text: The sturgeon's dried swim bladder (always 1 per sturgeon). **Crafting: 1 Isinglass → 2 [[hide_glue]]**: glue without a kettle.

oil_lamp.text: Crafting: 5 rock chunks and Plant Fibre (`[C][W][C]` / `[C][C][C]`). A stone dish with a wick. **Fill it with [[blubber]]** (or Tallow, Lard, Bear Fat), up to 4, and light it with a Fire Drill, Flint and Steel or a torch; an empty hand puts it out. Light 14, one fill lasts ~7 minutes.

entity:wolverine.text: Wolverine: solitary, low and heavy, in snowy taiga, snowy plains, groves and snowy slopes (rare, 1 at a time). Shy at a distance but stands its ground: come within 4 blocks without sneaking – or within 8 while it eats – and it attacks. **Thief:** steals carcasses (on the ground, by snares or hung on a [[hanging_rack]]) within 32 blocks, by day or night and unafraid of fire, eating them down to the bones; raids baited snares. 22 health, 5 damage. Drops [[raw_wolverine_pelt]], [[raw_wolverine]], [[wolverine_claw]], Sinew and Bone.

entity:lynx.text: Lynx: alone or a mother with her kitten in taiga, old-growth spruce/pine taiga, snowy taiga, dark forest and Pine Heath. Sleeps by day and slips away from people. **Hunts at night:** creeps up crouched, freezes while its quarry looks its way and pounces from 2–6 blocks (6 damage). Takes roe deer, hares, ptarmigans, squirrels and lemmings – and a **lone** player (nobody else within 24 blocks). Afraid of fire and torches. 20 health, 4 damage. Drops [[raw_lynx_pelt]], [[raw_lynx]], Sinew and Bone.

entity:ermine.text: Ermine: small and quick, in snowy lands and taiga (1–2). **White** in snow biomes, brown with a cream belly elsewhere, always a black tail tip. Bounds along in arcs and flees at once. Hunts lemmings and eats the body. 6 health. Drops [[raw_ermine_pelt]] and [[raw_ermine]]. Caught in a [[snare]].

entity:lemming.text: Norway lemming: tiny and round, in bunches (3–6) on snowy plains, ice spikes, groves and snowy slopes. Squeaks and lets you close. **Lemming years:** every 8th day (days 7–8 of the cycle) grown lemmings have young until there are 10 within 12 blocks. Prey for foxes, lynx and ermine; caught in a [[snare]]. 3 health. Drops [[raw_lemming]] and [[lemming_pelt]].

entity:pine_marten.text: Pine marten: solitary, in forest, birch forest, dark forest, taiga and Deciduous Forest/Pine Heath. Runs up the nearest tree when scared and waits under the crown. **Raids [[bird_nest]]s** within 16 blocks: eats an egg and leaves the shell ([[eggshell]]); the birds grow uneasy and abandon the nest as if a player had taken the eggs. Hunts squirrels. 10 health, 3 damage. Drops [[raw_marten_pelt]] and [[raw_marten]]. Caught in a [[snare]].

raw_wolverine.text: Second pass when butchering a [[entity:wolverine]] (1–3 with a flint knife; cut into Haunch/Ribs/Loin on a [[hanging_rack]]). Hunger 2. Campfire (20 s) or smoker → [[cooked_wolverine]]. Spoils in 1 day; can be smoked/dried.

cooked_wolverine.text: [[raw_wolverine]] on a Campfire. Tough and musky. Hunger 6, saturation 0.6. Spoils in 3 days.

raw_lynx.text: Second pass when butchering a [[entity:lynx]] (2–3). Pale, lean meat. Hunger 2. Campfire/smoker → [[cooked_lynx]]. Spoils in 1 day; can be smoked/dried.

cooked_lynx.text: [[raw_lynx]] on a Campfire. Hunger 6, saturation 0.7. Spoils in 3 days.

raw_ermine.text: Second pass when butchering an [[entity:ermine]] (1). Hunger 1. Campfire/smoker → [[cooked_ermine]]. Spoils in 1 day.

cooked_ermine.text: [[raw_ermine]] on a Campfire. Hunger 3, saturation 0.5. Spoils in 3 days.

raw_lemming.text: Second pass when butchering a [[entity:lemming]] (1). Hunger 1. Campfire/smoker → [[cooked_lemming]]. Spoils in 1 day.

cooked_lemming.text: [[raw_lemming]] roasted whole on a Campfire. Hunger 2, saturation 0.4. Spoils in 3 days.

raw_marten.text: Second pass when butchering a [[entity:pine_marten]] (1). Hunger 1. Campfire/smoker → [[cooked_marten]]. Spoils in 1 day.

cooked_marten.text: [[raw_marten]] on a Campfire. Hunger 3, saturation 0.6. Spoils in 3 days.

raw_wolverine_pelt.text: First pass when butchering a [[entity:wolverine]] (always 1). Stretched on a [[drying_rack]] (a normal spot, no tall rack needed) and dries like a Scraped Hide (~3 min) → [[wolverine_fur]].

wolverine_fur.text: Cured [[raw_wolverine_pelt]]. Frost does not cling to wolverine fur: 2 + Fur Hood + Sinew → [[wolverine_trimmed_hood]]. Repairs the hood.

wolverine_claw.text: Second pass from a [[entity:wolverine]] (60 %, 1–2). 2 claws + Stick + Sinew → [[claw_flesher]]. Repairs the Claw Flesher.

raw_lynx_pelt.text: First pass when butchering a [[entity:lynx]] (always 1). Stretched on a [[drying_rack]] (a normal spot; smaller than a wolf pelt) → [[lynx_pelt]] after ~3 min.

raw_ermine_pelt.text: First pass when butchering an [[entity:ermine]] (80 %). Dried on a [[drying_rack]] → [[ermine_fur]]. White and brown ermines give the same pelt.

ermine_fur.text: Cured [[raw_ermine_pelt]]: fine white luxury fur. 6 + Leather + Sinew → [[ermine_mantle]]. Repairs the mantle.

raw_marten_pelt.text: First pass when butchering a [[entity:pine_marten]] (90 %). Dried on a [[drying_rack]] → [[marten_fur]].

marten_fur.text: Cured [[raw_marten_pelt]]: dense, glossy and valuable. 5 + Sinew `MMM`/`M M`/` S ` → [[marten_fur_cap]]. Repairs the cap.

lemming_pelt.text: First pass from a [[entity:lemming]] (60 %). Too small to cure: 4 pelts + Twine → Raw Hide.

claw_flesher.text: 2 [[wolverine_claw]] + Stick + Sinew. A skinning knife (works in every knife recipe and for butchering): flint tier, 1.1× faster, **1.4× more hide/pelt** in the first pass (Tusk Dagger 1.6×). 90 durability.

wolverine_trimmed_hood.text: Fur Hood + 2 [[wolverine_fur]] + Sinew. Helmet, armour 1. **Blocks 25 % of the cold** (like the Fur Hood) and is **frost-proof**: no freezing damage (powder snow or bitter cold) while worn. Repaired with Wolverine Fur.

ermine_mantle.text: 6 [[ermine_fur]] + Leather + Sinew `E E`/`ELE`/`ESE`. Chest piece, armour 2. **Blocks 25 % of the cold**, very easy to enchant (22). A chieftain's mantle of white ermine with black tail tips.

marten_fur_cap.text: 5 [[marten_fur]] + Sinew. Helmet, armour 1. **Blocks 25 % of the cold.** Repaired with Marten Fur.

lynx_rug.text: 2 [[lynx_pelt]] + Bone. Flat decoration (like a rug) with the head facing away from whoever places it.

entity:ibex.text: Ibex (2–5) on peaks and windswept hills; replaces vanilla goats there. **Climbs rock faces** and flees uphill when you come close. Bucks carry huge knobbed horns and a beard and **butt each other** (knocked back, no damage). 18 health. Drops [[ibex_meat]], [[raw_ibex_pelt]], [[ibex_horn]] and Sinew.

entity:chamois.text: Chamois (2–4) on mountain meadows and slopes above the trees. Very skittish and quick, **flees up the rocks**. Short black hooked horns on both sexes. 12 health. Drops [[chamois_meat]], [[raw_chamois_hide]], [[chamois_horn]] and Sinew.

entity:marmot.text: Marmots in colonies (3–6) on mountain meadows, each with its **burrow**. One keeps watch: seeing a player (14 blocks, 5 sneaking) or a predator it sits up and **whistles** – every animal within 24 blocks flees and the colony dives into the burrows (hidden and out of reach until it's safe for ~10 s). Sleeps in the burrow at night. Can be caught in a [[snare]]. 8 health. Drops [[marmot_meat]], [[marmot_pelt]] and [[marmot_fat]].

entity:saiga.text: Saiga in herds (4–8) on savanna, plains, snowy plains and pine heath. **The most skittish game**: notices a walking hunter at ~22 blocks and outruns anything on foot – bring a bow. Big drooping nose; bucks carry amber horns. 12 health. Drops [[saiga_meat]], [[raw_saiga_pelt]], [[saiga_horn]] and Sinew.

entity:cave_bear.text: Cave bear: bigger and deadlier than the brown bear (90 health, 11 damage). Lives in **caves under the mountains** (spawns only in the dark, out of the sky) and **lies dormant** day and night until someone comes close – then it attacks. Rears and swipes like the brown bear, never flees. Only a [[tusk_dagger]] or better butchers it. Drops [[raw_cave_bear_pelt]], [[cave_bear_skull]], [[cave_bear_meat]], Bear Fat, Bear Claw and Sinew.

entity:cave_hyena.text: Cave hyena in packs (3–5) on savanna, plains and badlands; a night predator like the wolf (fears fire and torches). **Scavenger**: runs to any unwatched carcass within 24 blocks – yours too – and **drags it away**, then the pack guards it. At night a pack of 3+ **harasses** players: circles at 5–6 blocks, giggling, and darts in one at a time to bite. Big packs mob lone cave lions. 20 health, 4 damage. Drops [[hyena_meat]], [[raw_hyena_pelt]], [[hyena_fang]], Bone and Sinew.

ibex_meat.text: Raw Ibex meat. Cooks on a Campfire (20 s) or in a smoker; can be dried/smoked. Spoils in 1 day.

chamois_meat.text: Raw Chamois meat. Cooks on a Campfire (20 s) or in a smoker; can be dried/smoked. Spoils in 1 day.

marmot_meat.text: Raw Marmot meat. Cooks on a Campfire (20 s) or in a smoker; can be dried/smoked. Spoils in 1 day.

saiga_meat.text: Raw Saiga meat. Cooks on a Campfire (20 s) or in a smoker; can be dried/smoked. Spoils in 1 day.

cave_bear_meat.text: Raw Cave Bear meat. Cooks on a Campfire (20 s) or in a smoker; can be dried/smoked. Spoils in 1 day.

hyena_meat.text: Raw Cave Hyena meat. Cooks on a Campfire (20 s) or in a smoker; can be dried/smoked. Spoils in 1 day.

raw_ibex_pelt.text: First pass when butchering a Ibex. **Fat-tanned** in the grid: + knife + [[tallow]], [[lard]], [[bear_fat]] or [[marmot_fat]] → [[ibex_pelt]].

ibex_rug.text: 2 [[ibex_pelt]] + Bone (shapeless). Flat decoration, like a carpet.

raw_saiga_pelt.text: First pass when butchering a Saiga. **Fat-tanned** in the grid: + knife + [[tallow]], [[lard]], [[bear_fat]] or [[marmot_fat]] → [[saiga_pelt]].

saiga_rug.text: 2 [[saiga_pelt]] + Bone (shapeless). Flat decoration, like a carpet.

raw_hyena_pelt.text: First pass when butchering a Cave Hyena. **Fat-tanned** in the grid: + knife + [[tallow]], [[lard]], [[bear_fat]] or [[marmot_fat]] → [[hyena_pelt]].

hyena_rug.text: 2 [[hyena_pelt]] + Bone (shapeless). Flat decoration, like a carpet.

raw_chamois_hide.text: From the [[entity:chamois]]. + knife + [[tallow]], [[lard]], [[bear_fat]] or [[marmot_fat]] → [[chamois_leather]] (fat tanning, like real chamois leather).

chamois_leather.text: Soft fat-tanned leather. 3 + Sinew at the [[armor_station]] → [[chamois_boots]].

chamois_boots.text: [[armor_station]]: 3 [[chamois_leather]] + Sinew (Bone Needle). Armour 1 and **+3 safe fall distance** – the chamois' sure foot.

marmot_pelt.text: Small pelt from the [[entity:marmot]], used as it is: 3 + Sinew at the [[armor_station]] → Fur Hood or Fur Boots.

raw_cave_bear_pelt.text: From the [[entity:cave_bear]] (needs a [[tusk_dagger]] or better). Dried on a **tall** [[drying_rack]], taking the whole rack → [[cave_bear_pelt]].

cave_bear_pelt.text: A huge pelt: at the [[armor_station]] 2 → Fur Coat, 1 → Fur Leggings (fewer than the bear's); + Bear Claw → [[cave_bear_rug]].

cave_bear_skull.text: Always comes out of a butchered [[entity:cave_bear]]. A trophy: sits on the floor or a shelf, muzzle towards you. The high domed brow sets it apart from a brown bear's.

ibex_horn.text: From the ibex. [[fletching_table]]: 2 Sinew + [[sinew_bow]] + 2 horns → [[horn_bow]]. + knife → [[bone_needle]].

horn_bow.text: **Composite bow** ([[fletching_table]]: 2 Sinew + [[sinew_bow]] + 2 [[ibex_horn]]). Arrows fly 20 % faster – more damage and range – and truer. 384 durability.

marmot_fat.text: From the marmot. Campfire → [[tallow]]; tans hides; 2 + Juniper Berries → 2 [[marmot_salve]].

marmot_salve.text: 2 [[marmot_fat]] + Juniper Berries → 2. Rub it on (hold right-click): Regeneration I for 15 s.

saiga_horn.text: Amber, translucent horn from saiga bucks. 4 + 5 Sticks → 4 [[horn_window]]; + knife → [[bone_needle]].

horn_window.text: 4 [[saiga_horn]] + 5 Sticks → 4. A see-through window of thin-scraped horn in a wooden lattice: amber light long before glass.

hyena_fang.text: From the cave hyena. [[fletching_table]]: + Stick + Feather → 4 Barbed Arrows (like a Bear Claw).

entity:wild_cat.text: Shy, nocturnal wild cat (grey-brown tabby with a thick ringed tail) of forest edges and meadows. Flees players from far off, sleeps by day and hunts voles, moles, squirrels, rabbits and ground birds at night: creeps up low and springs the last bit. Alone, sometimes a mother with a kitten. Gives [[raw_wildcat_pelt]], [[raw_wildcat]] and sometimes Sinew.

entity:mole.text: Mole of meadows, plains and field edges. Lives underground: burrowed it can't be seen or hit, and it pushes up [[molehill]]s – on farmland the crop pops off and the soil turns to Dirt, on paths the path breaks up. Surfaces now and then (mostly at night) and digs back in when it notices a player. Dig up a fresh molehill to flush it out, or set a Snare over its runs. Gives [[raw_mole_pelt]] and [[raw_mole]].

entity:field_vole.text: Field vole of plains, meadows and fields, in small colonies. **A pest at night near fields:** nibbles crops (a growing crop drops 2 stages, a fresh seedling is eaten) and gets into chests and barrels within 8 blocks of farmland, eating grain from them (#mechanical:vole_food, 1–2 at a time). Clay jars, the root cellar and bark baskets keep it out. Every third meal it has 1–2 young if the colony is small (fewer than 6). Flees wild cats, foxes and cats (a cat on the farm keeps voles away). Caught in Snares. Follows mobGriefing. Gives [[raw_vole]].

entity:adder.text: Adder of heaths (Pine Heath), meadows and sunny rocks; the male grey, the female brown, both with a black zigzag. Doesn't flee but trusts its camouflage, basks coiled and **strikes anyone who walks right up to it without sneaking** (Poison I 6 s, 2 damage). [[snakeskin_boots]] stop the bite. After a strike it slips away. Gives [[snakeskin]], [[raw_snake]] and [[venom_gland]].

entity:grass_snake.text: Grass snake near water (swamps, Willow Fen, rivers) and in damp meadows; olive green with a yellow-and-black collar. Harmless, swims well and slides away. Hurt, it often **plays dead**: rolls belly up with its tongue out for a few seconds, then flees. Gives [[snakeskin]] and [[raw_snake]].

raw_wildcat.text: From a Wild Cat (1–2). Cook on a Campfire (20 s) or in a smoker → [[cooked_wildcat]]. Can be smoked and dried. 2 hunger. Spoils in 1 day.

cooked_wildcat.text: Cooked [[raw_wildcat]]. 5 hunger, 0.7 saturation. Spoils in 3 days.

raw_mole.text: A skinned mole (1 per animal). Cook on a Campfire → [[cooked_mole]]. 1 hunger. Spoils in 1 day.

cooked_mole.text: Cooked [[raw_mole]]. 3 hunger, 0.6 saturation. Spoils in 3 days.

raw_vole.text: A small skinned vole (1 per animal). Cook on a Campfire → [[cooked_vole]]. 1 hunger. Spoils in 1 day.

cooked_vole.text: Cooked [[raw_vole]]. 2 hunger, 0.5 saturation. Spoils in 3 days.

raw_snake.text: Snake meat from the Adder (1) and Grass Snake (1–2). Cook on a Campfire → [[cooked_snake]]. Can be smoked and dried. 1 hunger. Spoils in 1 day.

cooked_snake.text: Cooked [[raw_snake]]. 4 hunger, 0.6 saturation. Spoils in 3 days.

raw_wildcat_pelt.text: First round when butchering a [[entity:wild_cat]] (90 %). Scraped with a knife in the grid (the knife stays) → [[wildcat_pelt]].

wildcat_pelt.text: Scraped [[raw_wildcat_pelt]]. 2 pelts + Sinew → [[wildcat_fur_cap]]. Repairs the Wildcat Fur Cap.

raw_mole_pelt.text: First round when butchering a [[entity:mole]] (85 %). Scraped with a knife in the grid → [[moleskin]].

moleskin.text: The mole's fine velvet fur, soft and supple. 3 Moleskin + Twine (` T `/`M M`/` M `) → Bundle.

snakeskin.text: First round when butchering an Adder or Grass Snake (85 %). Leather Boots + 2 Snakeskin + Sinew → [[snakeskin_boots]]. Repairs Snakeskin Boots.

venom_gland.text: From an [[entity:adder]], second round (75 %). 8 Arrows around a gland → 8 Arrows of Poison. Venom Gland + Lard + Plant Fibre → 2 [[snakebite_poultice]].

snakebite_poultice.text: Venom Gland + Lard + Plant Fibre → 2. Eaten (1 s): **removes Poison** (adder bites, fly agaric).

wildcat_fur_cap.text: 2 [[wildcat_pelt]] + Sinew (shapeless). A cap of tabby fur with the ringed tail down the back of the neck. Armor 1, repaired with Wildcat Pelt.

snakeskin_boots.text: Leather Boots + 2 [[snakeskin]] + Sinew (shapeless). Armor 1. **An adder can't bite through them**: the bite catches the boots (1 wear) instead of poisoning.

molehill.text: Small mound of earth pushed up by a [[entity:mole]]. Walkable, settles back by itself after about half an hour. Digging one up flushes a burrowed mole nearby. Sometimes gives Dirt.

entity:beaver.text: Beaver by forest streams, rivers and lakes (rare). Shy; slaps its tail on the water as it flees. With mobGriefing on it fells small trees (at most 16 logs) towards the water, gnaws the fallen logs into building stuff and builds a **dam** of [[beaver_dam]] across a narrow stream (2–7 blocks, two courses), then a **lodge**. A finished dam raises the water one block behind it if that pond is closed in (at most 64 blocks). Gives [[raw_beaver_pelt]], [[raw_beaver]], [[beaver_tail]], [[castoreum]] and [[beaver_tooth]].

entity:otter.text: Otter along rivers, fens and rocky shores. Fast swimmer and playful; dives for fish and eats them on the bank. Steals fish lying on the ground or drying on a [[drying_rack]], but only when no player is within 12 blocks and at most once a day. Gives [[raw_otter_pelt]] and [[raw_otter]].

entity:mosquito_swarm.text: Mosquito swarm over the water in the Willow Fen and swamps, at dusk and on warm nights. Buzzes round your head: a bite every 3 seconds (−1 sanity, sometimes ½ heart). **Smoke and fire drive it off:** a burning campfire within 6 blocks or a smoky room. Dies to one hit; no carcass, no drops.

raw_beaver.text: Beaver meat from a [[entity:beaver]]. Cooked on a Campfire or in a Smoker into [[cooked_beaver]]. Spoils in 1 day; can be dried and smoked.

beaver_tail.text: The fatty, scaly beaver tail (always one per beaver). Roasted on a Campfire into [[roasted_beaver_tail]].

roasted_beaver_tail.text: Roasted [[beaver_tail]]: a fatty delicacy, 7 hunger and high saturation. Spoils in 3 days.

raw_otter.text: Lean, fishy otter meat from an [[entity:otter]]. Cooked into [[cooked_otter]]. Spoils in 1 day.

raw_beaver_pelt.text: Fresh beaver pelt. Laced into a [[pelt_hoop]] it cures outdoors by day into a [[beaver_pelt]].

beaver_pelt.text: Cured beaver pelt, dense and waterproof. 2 + [[sinew]] → [[beaver_fur_hat]].

raw_otter_pelt.text: Fresh otter pelt. Laced into a [[pelt_hoop]] it cures into an [[otter_pelt]].

otter_pelt.text: Cured otter pelt, the finest and most waterproof. 3 + 2 [[sinew]] → [[otter_fur_cape]].

castoreum.text: The beaver's scent glands. **Snare bait** ([[snare]], tag snare_bait) and an ingredient of [[castoreum_salve]].

beaver_tooth.text: The beaver's orange incisor (0–2 per beaver). Made into a [[beaver_tooth_knife]].

castoreum_salve.text: [[castoreum]] + [[tallow]] + Bark → 2. Rub it in: Regeneration I for 10 s and removes Poison.

beaver_tooth_knife.text: Crafted like the Flint Knife with a [[beaver_tooth]]: `[B][ ]` / `[T][S]` (Twine, Stick). A knife (all knife recipes and butchering): 1.2× faster than the [[flint_knife]], 96 durability.

beaver_fur_hat.text: 2 [[beaver_pelt]] + [[sinew]]. Helmet, 1 armor. **Insulates 20 %** against the cold and is **waterproof**: halves the chill of water and rain.

otter_fur_cape.text: 3 [[otter_pelt]] + 2 [[sinew]]. Chestplate, 2 armor. **Insulates 20 %** and is **waterproof** (halves the chill of water and rain; with a [[beaver_fur_hat]] it is gone).

beaver_dam.text: Sticks and mud that beavers pack into dams and lodges. Drops 1–3 Sticks.

pelt_hoop.text: Stretching Hoop: 4 Sticks round a Twine. Right-click with a [[raw_beaver_pelt]] or [[raw_otter_pelt]]; it cures outdoors by day without rain (about 4 min). Empty hand takes it off.

entity:onager.text: Onager (wild ass) in small herds (2–5) on savanna, desert and badlands (rarely plains). Even shyer and faster than the wild horse (22 health, speed 0.34); never fights. **Tamable** like the wild horse: crouch with horse feed and hand-feed it (once per 10 s), at trust 3 put a [[rope_halter]] on it, at trust 7 it becomes a [[entity:tame_onager]]. Hurting it costs all its trust. Drops [[onager_meat]], [[raw_onager_hide]], Sinew.

entity:tame_onager.text: A tamed onager: a **pack animal**. Ridden bareback (no saddle needed, 85 % speed), takes [[pack_baskets]] (right-click) for a 15-slot pack (sneak + right-click opens it), and pulls the [[cart]] like a horse. 18–24 health, speed 0.2–0.28. Two tame onagers bred with sheaves or hay foal a tame one.

entity:tortoise.text: Tortoise, alone or in twos on desert, savanna and badlands. Very slow (16 health, armour 6). Doesn't flee: when a player comes within 4 blocks (sneaking: 1.5) or it is hurt, it **withdraws into its shell** for ~8 s; withdrawn, the shell takes **80 % of every blow** (not fire, falls or armour-piercing damage). Drops [[tortoise_shell]] (always, first pass) and [[tortoise_meat]].

entity:desert_lizard.text: Desert lizard (agama) on desert, badlands, savanna and Pine Heath. Quick (4 health, speed 0.36); by day it **basks** flat in the sun and notices you later. Hit by a blow that wouldn't kill it, it often (70 %) **sheds its tail**: no damage, a [[lizard_tail]] drops and it sprints off; the tail grows back in a day. Small enough for a snare. Drops [[lizard_tail]], [[lizard_skin]].

entity:water_buffalo.text: Water buffalo in herds (3–5) in jungle, swamp, mangrove swamp and Willow Fen. Huge (48 health, 8 damage, knockback resistance 0.7) with great swept-back horns. Hurt one and **every grown buffalo within 16 blocks charges you**. By day it **wallows** in shallow water or mud. Thick hide: butcher with a [[tusk_dagger]] or better. Drops [[buffalo_meat]], [[raw_buffalo_hide]], [[buffalo_horn]], Sinew, Lard.

entity:tapir.text: Tapir, alone or a mother with a striped calf, in jungle. Shy (26 health). Frightened, it **runs to the nearest deep water** within 16 blocks and stays in it until the danger has passed. Drops [[tapir_meat]], [[raw_tapir_hide]], Lard.

entity:leopard.text: Leopard, alone, in jungle and savanna (also arrives at night like the cave lion). A night predator that hunts like the cave lion: creeps crouched, freezes when watched, **pounces** (8 damage); fears fire and torches. By day it **climbs a tree** and sleeps on the canopy, and drops onto prey passing below. A fresh kill it **hauls up its tree** and leaves in the branches. Ignores the first 10 blocks of a fall. 24 health. Drops [[leopard_meat]], [[raw_leopard_pelt]], Sinew, Bone.

entity:hornbill.text: Great hornbill, flocks of 2–4 in jungle; flies high and perches on the canopy, with a loud bray. 8 health; any arrow kills. Leaves a carcass: plucked for Feathers and its [[hornbill_casque]], then [[raw_hornbill]]; or taken whole as a [[plucked_hornbill]].

entity:jungle_fowl.text: Red jungle fowl, the chicken's wild ancestor, 2–4 on the jungle floor. Sits tight and bursts up like a pheasant. Roosters (red comb, sickle tail) crow at dawn; hens **lay a [[jungle_fowl_egg]]** on the ground every 5–10 minutes. 5 health, snareable. Leaves a carcass: Feathers, then [[raw_jungle_fowl]] (or whole: [[plucked_jungle_fowl]]).

entity:peafowl.text: Peafowl, 2–3 in jungle and savanna. The peacock now and then **raises his train into a fan** and rattles it, with a scream; the peahen is brown. 8 health. Leaves a carcass: Feathers and (60 %) 1–3 [[peacock_feather]], then [[raw_peafowl]] (or whole: [[plucked_peafowl]]).

onager_meat.text: Raw onager meat. Cooks on a Campfire (20 s) or in a smoker into [[cooked_onager_meat]]; can be dried/smoked. Spoils in 1 day.

tortoise_meat.text: Raw tortoise meat. Cooks into [[cooked_tortoise_meat]]; can be dried/smoked; good in the kettle. Spoils in 1 day.

lizard_tail.text: The desert lizard's meat: its tail. Also what it leaves in your hand when it escapes. Cooks into [[cooked_lizard_tail]]. Spoils in 1 day.

buffalo_meat.text: Raw water buffalo meat. Cooks into [[cooked_buffalo_meat]]; can be dried/smoked. Spoils in 1 day.

cooked_buffalo_meat.text: Cooked [[buffalo_meat]]: 3 hunger, well saturating. Spoils in 3 days.

tapir_meat.text: Raw tapir meat. Cooks into [[cooked_tapir_meat]]; can be dried/smoked. Spoils in 1 day.

leopard_meat.text: Raw leopard meat, dark and stringy. Cooks into [[cooked_leopard_meat]]. Spoils in 1 day.

raw_hornbill.text: Raw hornbill: like raw chicken, a chance of Hunger. Cooks into [[cooked_hornbill]]. Spoils in 1 day.

plucked_hornbill.text: A whole plucked hornbill (empty hand on the plucked carcass). Roasts whole on the Campfire (30 s) or is cut with a knife into [[raw_hornbill]]; the kettle boils it.

raw_jungle_fowl.text: Raw jungle fowl: a chance of Hunger. Cooks into [[cooked_jungle_fowl]]. Spoils in 1 day.

plucked_jungle_fowl.text: A whole plucked jungle fowl. Roasts whole or is cut into [[raw_jungle_fowl]].

raw_peafowl.text: Raw peafowl: a chance of Hunger. Cooks into [[cooked_peafowl]]. Spoils in 1 day.

plucked_peafowl.text: A whole plucked peafowl. Roasts whole or is cut into [[raw_peafowl]].

jungle_fowl_egg.text: Laid on the ground by jungle fowl hens. Boils on the Campfire into a [[boiled_egg]]. **Thrown**, it may hatch a chick like a hen's egg: the chicken comes from the jungle.

raw_onager_hide.text: First pass when butchering an onager. + knife (shapeless) → 1 [[scraped_hide]].

raw_tapir_hide.text: Thick hide from the tapir. + knife → 2 [[scraped_hide]].

raw_buffalo_hide.text: Huge thick hide from the water buffalo. + knife → 3 [[scraped_hide]].

raw_leopard_pelt.text: First pass when butchering a leopard. **Fat-tanned** in the grid: + knife + [[tallow]], [[lard]] or [[bear_fat]] → [[leopard_pelt]].

leopard_pelt.text: Cured rosette-spotted pelt. 2 + Bone → [[leopard_rug]]; + knife → 2 Leather.

lizard_skin.text: Fine scaly skin from the desert lizard. 3 (shapeless) → 1 Leather.

tortoise_shell.text: Comes off a butchered tortoise first. + knife → 2 Bowls; Planks + Scraped Hide around it → **Shield**; + Twine, Gravel, Stick → [[shell_rattle]].

buffalo_horn.text: From the water buffalo. + knife → 2 [[bone_needle]]; 2 around a Torch with 2 Cordage → a **Lantern** (horn panes).

hornbill_casque.text: The hornbill's casque, "red ivory". + knife → 2 [[bone_needle]]; alone → 2 Orange Dye.

peacock_feather.text: An eyed train feather from a peacock. + knife → 3 Feathers (fletching); 2 → Cyan Dye.

pack_baskets.text: 2 [[bark_basket]] + [[scraped_hide]] + 2 [[cordage]]. Right-click a [[entity:tame_onager]] with it: a 15-slot pack (sneak + right-click opens). Comes back off when it dies.

shell_rattle.text: [[tortoise_shell]] + Twine + Gravel + Stick. Held in either hand it **keeps predators off like a torch**, without fire.

leopard_rug.text: 2 [[leopard_pelt]] + Bone (shapeless). Flat decoration, like a carpet.

furnace_chute.text: The Smelting Furnace's roof: a firebrick funnel with a hole down into the chamber. Recipe: 3 [[furnace_brick]] `[B][ ][B]` / `[ ][B][ ]`. Sits in the middle of the top layer. **Throw ore, ingots and Charcoal onto it**: whatever falls into the funnel (or lies on its rim) is taken in. What doesn't fit is thrown back. Glows in the hole while the furnace burns, and the melt shows through it. Mined with a pickaxe.

hide_canvas.text: 2 [[scraped_hide]] + [[cordage]] (shapeless). A full block of sewn hides (hair side out, flesh side in): the back wall of a tent. Tribes that settle near your camp build their tents of them.

hide_tent_slope.text: 2 [[hide_canvas]] + Stick (`C `/`SC`) → 2. A hide wall at 45° rising away from you: the sides of a tent. Sneak + right-click with an empty hand for a triangular gable on its left or right (the back end of a tent).

hide_tent_ridge.text: 2 [[hide_canvas]] + Stick (` S `/`C C`) → 2. The top of a tent: two hide slopes meeting at a ridge pole, the open end toward you. Sneak + right-click with an empty hand to close the back end. Slopes along the sides, ridges on top: an A-frame tent like the tribes'.

bronze_arrowhead.text: Ground on a [[whetstone]]: 4 strokes on [[rough_cast_bronze_arrowheads]] give 4. 4 of them + [[minecraft:stick]] + [[minecraft:feather]] at the Fletching Table give 4 [[bronze_arrow]]. Poor Bronze carries over.

rough_cast_bronze_arrowheads.text: Cast from 2 units of bronze in a [[clay_arrowheads_mold]]: four arrowheads on a sprue. Ground on the [[whetstone]] into 4 [[bronze_arrowhead]].

bronze_arrow.text: 4 [[bronze_arrowhead]] + [[minecraft:stick]] + [[minecraft:feather]] at the Fletching Table give 4. **3 damage** (Arrow 2) and breaks only 10 % of the time when it falls out of an animal. Poor Bronze: 2.5 damage.

clay_arrowheads_mold.text: Fired from an [[unfired_clay_arrowheads_mold]] in the kiln (600°). Takes 2 units of bronze and gives [[rough_cast_bronze_arrowheads]]. Bronze only. Cracks after 5 casts.

unfired_clay_arrowheads_mold.text: 3 [[minecraft:clay_ball]] at the [[mold_bench]]. Fired in the kiln into a [[clay_arrowheads_mold]].

broom.text: Tool Station: [[straw]] + [[twine]] + [[tool_rod]]. Right-click soot: all [[soot]] in a 3×3 gets one stage lighter (the lightest is swept away). Also sweeps leaf litter a leaf at a time. 96 durability, 1 per sweep.

bat_wing.text: The bat's thin wing membrane, from a butchered bat (85 %, 1–2). 2 of them with [[soot]] and [[lard]] make [[night_eye_salve]].

night_eye_salve.text: 2 [[bat_wing]] + [[soot]] + [[lard]] (shapeless) make 2. Rubbed under the eyes: Night Vision for 90 s.

guano.text: Bat droppings from a [[guano_pile]] under a cave roost. The strongest fertiliser: right-click farmland, fertility **+3** (poor soil turns rich at once).

guano_pile.text: Builds up on the floor under resting bats (1–4 layers). Break it for 1 [[guano]] per layer.

venison_jerky.text: Dried in the sun on a [[drying_rack]] from: Venison Scraps, Saiga Meat (hangs as meat strips). 3 hunger, 0.8 saturation. **Keeps 30 days**. Counts towards the three-kinds advancement.

beef_jerky.text: Dried in the sun on a [[drying_rack]] from: Raw Beef, Beef Scraps, Raw Bison, Bison Tongue, Buffalo Meat, Raw Musk Ox (hangs as meat strips). 3 hunger, 0.9 saturation. **Keeps 30 days**. Counts towards the three-kinds advancement.

dried_pork.text: Dried in the sun on a [[drying_rack]] from: Raw Porkchop, Porkchop Scraps, Tapir Meat (hangs as meat strips). 3 hunger, 0.7 saturation. **Keeps 20 days**. Counts towards the three-kinds advancement.

dried_mutton.text: Dried in the sun on a [[drying_rack]] from: Raw Mutton, Mutton Scraps, Ibex Meat, Chamois Meat (hangs as meat strips). 3 hunger, 0.8 saturation. **Keeps 30 days**. Counts towards the three-kinds advancement.

game_jerky.text: Dried in the sun on a [[drying_rack]] from: Game Meat Scraps, Raw Mammoth, Raw Rhino, Onager/Hyena/Leopard Meat, Raw Lynx, Raw Wolverine, Raw Wildcat (hangs as meat strips). 2 hunger, 0.8 saturation. **Keeps 30 days**. Counts towards the three-kinds advancement.

small_game_jerky.text: Dried in the sun on a [[drying_rack]] from: Raw Rabbit, Rabbit Scraps, Raw Ermine/Lemming/Marten/Mole/Vole/Otter/Snake, Marmot Meat, Lizard Tail, Tortoise Meat (hangs as meat strips). 2 hunger, 0.6 saturation. **Keeps 30 days**. Counts towards the three-kinds advancement.

dried_fowl.text: Dried in the sun on a [[drying_rack]] from: Raw Chicken, Chicken Scraps and every bird (Goose, Pheasant, Ptarmigan, Pigeon, Capercaillie, Bustard, Hornbill, Jungle Fowl, Peafowl, Mallard, Swan, Heron, Crane) (hangs as birds). 2 hunger, 0.7 saturation. **Keeps 30 days**. Counts towards the three-kinds advancement.

dried_seal_meat.text: Dried in the sun on a [[drying_rack]] from: Raw Seal Meat (hangs as meat strips). 3 hunger, 0.9 saturation. **Keeps 20 days**. Counts towards the three-kinds advancement.

stockfish.text: Dried in the sun on a [[drying_rack]] from: Raw Cod, Raw Pike, Raw Sturgeon (hangs as fish). 2 hunger, 0.8 saturation. **Never spoils** (dried bone-hard). Counts towards the three-kinds advancement.

raw_meat_strips.text: A big cut ([[raw_haunch]] 3, [[raw_ribs]] / [[raw_loin]] 2) + knife (shapeless, the knife loses 1). Thin enough to dry: on a [[drying_rack]] they become [[jerky]]; can also be smoked into [[smoked_meat]]. 1 hunger. Spoils in 1 day.

smoked_haunch.text: A whole [[raw_haunch]] smoked 4 min on a [[smoking_rack]]. 9 hunger, 0.8 saturation. **Keeps 30 days**. A knife in the crafting grid slices it into 3 [[smoked_meat]].

smoked_ribs.text: A whole [[raw_ribs]] smoked 4 min on a [[smoking_rack]]. 6 hunger, 0.8 saturation. **Keeps 30 days**. A knife in the crafting grid slices it into 2 [[smoked_meat]].

smoked_loin.text: A whole [[raw_loin]] smoked 4 min on a [[smoking_rack]]. 6 hunger, 0.9 saturation. **Keeps 30 days**. A knife in the crafting grid slices it into 2 [[smoked_meat]].

oak_firewood_pile.text: **Right-click the top of a solid block with [[oak_firewood]]** to lay a woodpile (not on fires, stations or blocks with contents; sneaking does nothing). Each piece is a layer of 2 billets, 8 layers = a full block; more of the same wood stacks on and carries on in the block above. An empty hand takes a piece back, breaking it drops them all. The cut ends face whoever stacked it. A burning Fire Pit with no firewood left stacked on it takes firewood from a pile beside it (within 2 blocks). No item of its own.

stinging_nettle.text: Stinging nettle (Urtica dioica) in forests (forest, flower forest, birch forest, dark forest, Deciduous Forest: patches, 1/5 per chunk) and along riverbanks, swamps and Willow Fen (only right beside water). **Stings:** walking through without anything on your legs costs half a heart about once a second; sneak or wear leggings. Gives 1–2 [[nettle_stalks]] and sometimes [[nettle_seeds]] (knife/sickle 35 %, by hand 20 %).

nettle_seeds.text: Seeds from [[stinging_nettle]]. Planted on soil as a small seedling that doesn't sting; it grows up in daylight. A broken seedling gives its seed back.

nettle_stalks.text: Stalks from [[stinging_nettle]]. With a knife in the crafting grid: 2 [[nettle_fiber]] (the knife loses 1). Compostable.

nettle_fiber.text: Bast stripped from [[nettle_stalks]]. Spun on a [[drop_spindle]] into [[nettle_thread]].

nettle_thread.text: Thread spun from [[nettle_fiber]] on a [[drop_spindle]]. Sews leather like any thread (tag **#mechanical:threads**).

sinew_thread.text: [[sinew]] split with a knife in the crafting grid: 2 Sinew Thread (the knife loses 1). Sews leather at the Armor Station (tag **#mechanical:threads**).

drop_spindle.text: The Stone Age spindle: a Stick over a whorl of rock (rock chunk), Bone or Clay Ball. Stays in the crafting grid and loses 1 per thread (64 uses). Fibre + spindle → thread: [[nettle_fiber]] → [[nettle_thread]], [[flax_fiber]] → [[linen_thread]], any wool → 3 [[wool_thread]].

flax_seeds.text: Flax seed, a Bronze Age crop. Bought from a village Farmer at trade level 3 (2 Emerald → 4 Flax Seeds, max 12). Sown on farmland as [[flax_crop]].

flax_crop.text: Flax on farmland, age 0–7 (blue flowers before it ripens golden). Grows at 5–16 (best 8–13), frost-hardy down to 0, like barley. Ripe: 2 [[flax_stalks]] (sickle: 50 % one more) and 1–2 [[flax_seeds]]; unripe gives nothing. Follows all farming rules (daylight, moisture, fertility, crows).

flax_stalks.text: Flax stalks. **Retting:** 4 Flax Stalks + Clay Water Bucket (or water bucket) + knife → 6 [[flax_fiber]]; the bucket comes back empty, the knife loses 1. Compostable.

flax_fiber.text: Retted and scutched flax bast. Spun on a [[drop_spindle]] into [[linen_thread]].

linen_thread.text: Linen thread spun from [[flax_fiber]] on a [[drop_spindle]]. Sews leather at the Armor Station (tag **#mechanical:threads**).
